Eventually, Shiro's condition got to the point where she needed a transplant, or else she would die. Kuro then offers her heart to Shiro, and has hers replaced by a mechanical one. This story is about them adjusting to their new hearts and to their feelings for each other.

112064.description:
Minami and Kita are complete opposites in terms of looks, personality, and even their areas of study. And yet, thanks to one car accident, their paths have crossed and are forever intertwined. Kita grows closer to Minami and desperately requests to use her body…

Two years later, there is a child that looks a lot like Minami -- they’re the child of Kita and Minami, yet they’re both women. What were the painful circumstances that led to this moment of happiness? How did a love bloom between two broken women?

112065.description:
In this world, where Omegas are rare, there is a rumor about a problematic Omega who is like a honey trap… None can escape his seduction. Omaki Kazua, who was waiting to get his secondary gender test results, comes across Kurogane (An Alpha) and Nadame Sachiyuki (An Omega) having sex at school. Sachiyuki approaches him claiming that they are "Fated Mates”, but Omaki and the others refuse to believe this. However, Sachiyuki, who turns out to be the infamous "Problematic Omega", refuses to back down.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

112066.description:
Cafe manager Arata is almost 30, and he can't get girls because he's just too big! But, everything changes when he meets Shinya, a serious and way-too-innocent college-student who also happens to be a rare form of succubus... a male one. Shinya feeds off of a certain bodily fluid that Arata finds himself all too happy to provide. The sheer contrast between Shinya when he's "feeding" and his usual good-boy self is just irresistible in this ultra-fluffy, sweet, sultry romantic comedy! This book edition includes the bonus, never-before-released 30-page comic "My Sugar Succubus"!

(Source: Renta!)

They don't miss an opportunity to smooch whenever their parents are out, and work hard on their finals and part-time jobs so they can live together one day. It's no surprise they go wild on their graduation trip...! Who fell in love first? This story follows two childhood friends who spend their school days totally besotted with each other! Enjoy this super-sweet, warm and fuzzy, extra-naughty series from Sakana Tohjo, all in one volume!

(Source: Renta!)

Yanagawa just couldn't get the feeling of Sato's smooth white skin and the shape of his body out of his head! The next day, Yanagawa's pre-tournament slump took a turn for the better, and he was back in top form! Sato, too, seemed to have solved his problems with his role! 112077.description:
As a child, Guy Ninemann claimed to have nine lives. As an adult, he does. Out in the city one day, a homeless man shows him nine tally marks spray-painted on a wall, and the image lodges itself inside his mind. Before he can make any sense of what is going on, he is kidnapped, sees his city destroyed and is shot dead. But the end of one life throws him into the middle of another. Ninemann awakes in a new body, in a new time, in a new place – but with all his old memories. Each new life brings its own mission to complete – and linking them all, the explosion that destroys the city. Inspired by the classic 80s Taiwanese sci-fi graphic novel Nine Lives Man, this fast-paced and intricate story challenges our understanding of time. Beautifully drawn, this is a banquet of suspense, detective work and mind-bending sci-fi.

There’s Joonhyuk, an ASMR fan, Hyesoo, who has an amazing voice (but who only joins because he’s got a huge crush on Joonhyuk), and Chanyoung, who joins to protect (?) Joonhyuk from Hyesoo. From the creator of “Voice of Love” comes a new BL series full of budding romance and tingles!

(Source: Lezhin US)

112132.description: The original manga adaptation that depicts the roots of Tokunana! Follow a group of misfit, rough-around-the-edges police officers as they cause mayhem.
synonyms: Metropolitan Police Department Special Division Heinous Crime Investigation Unit Special 7: Tokunana - File.0

title.native: 警視庁 特務部 特殊凶悪犯対策室 第七課 トクナナ File.0
title.romaji: Keishicho Tokumu-bu Tokushu Kyoaku-han Taisaku-Shitsu Dai-Nana-ka: Tokunana - File.0

112133.description:
Yukio was kidnapped from the human world as a child and grew up in the spirit world. One day, when she's running a pharmacy as an adult, a man Shirotsuki appears in front of Yukio and marries her. But after the wedding, he abandons her and they are divorced.

But suddenly, he appears again and asks Yukio for reconciliation-!?

The marital love fantasy of a girl in a drugstore and a youth.

112134.description: Manga adaptation of the mobile game Kirara Fantasia.
synonyms: Manga Time Kirara Meets Fantasy RPG

112146.description:
Eric has had a hard life. At the age of 16, his village was overrun by monsters, who killed his friends and family. He soon became a soldier, but failed to save the life of the woman he loved. In the end, he died on the battlefield, surrounded by the bodies of those who he couldn’t protect.
When Eric wakes up, he finds himself in a baby’s body. Realizing he has been reincarnated, he quickly wonders what is going on before he gets another shocker: the man and woman who are raising him are in fact his previous life’s parents!
That’s right - Eric was reincarnated, but as himself. No alternate worlds, no skill trees, just his memories sent back to the moment he popped out of his mother. Armed with the knowledge of his past self, Eric vows to save everyone now that the universe has pushed the reset button for him.
synonyms: After Being Reborn, I Became the Strongest to Save Everyone

title.native: 死に戻り、全てを救うために最強へと至る
title.romaji: Shi ni Modori, Subete wo Sukuu Tame ni Saikyou He to Itaru

112147.description:
“I’ll redo every single one of my regrets. I’ll live my life with my head held up in pride, and change my fate!”

Eric's life was stricken with hardship, and after years of enduring the losses of those most precious to him, he finally dies on the battlefield. However, the end of his life was really a second beginning. He finds himself reborn at the very start of his life, with all his memories intact. Now, as the only one who knows the dark fate that awaits everyone he cares about, he must do what he can to become the strongest and save them all.

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: After Being Reborn, I Became the Strongest to Save Everyone

title.romaji: Shi ni Modori, Subete wo Sukuu Tame ni Saikyou e to Itaru @comic

112148.description: The unknown interior designer, Hans Duan (22 years old), was involved in a criminal dispute as he designed the house for one of the members in that group. Unfortunately, he was persecuted as a murderer due to the case and sentenced to death. In the prison, he met a scientist from the government (Code name No.73) who asked him to take part in a human experiment. But the experiment failed and Hans died. His body was buried in a dump in the city. However, the experimental medicine left in his body leads to gene mutation. Hans is revived and changed into a female. What will happen on him (her)?

112149.description: "Have we met before?" Bryony slaps her lover's face the moment she hears those heartless words. Five months ago, she fell in love with CEO Rafael, who came to buy her island. They spent an incredible time together, but afterward they lost contact with each other. When she found out that she was pregnant, Bryony began to fear that Rafael seduced her to get her property. Hoping to see him at a party, Bryony gathers up her courage to crash it... but she can't believe her ears when she finds out the truth. He claims that he has lost all memory of her from a plane crash accident!

title.native: 忘却のかなたの楽園 誘惑された花嫁
title.romaji: Boukyaku no Kanata no Rakuen: Yuuwakusareta Hanayome

112150.description:
When the monstrous Jave attacked, mankind’s strongest warrior died defending humanity—and was reincarnated as a baby. Now, thirteen years later, the Jave have returned! Enrolling in an academy that trains people to use the magic-powered battlesuits known as Division Maneuver, Okegawa Kuon can only operate Division 1, the weakest—until the opportunity to pilot a special, one-of-a-kind suit appears, one that can be activated even with rock-bottom levels of magical power!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: ディヴィジョン・マニューバ ―英雄転生―

title.native: ディヴィジョン・マニューバ

112154.description:
Renellette is the beautiful daughter of a Count, with a position, an education, and enough property befitting her status, yet somehow she can't get married. One day, while searching for a marriage partner, she meets a man who rekindles memories of her past lives, a stalker who interferes with her marriage every time Renellete reincarnates! She struggles to shake off the obstacles between her and a happy marriage in this life, but his shadow is always flickering behind her... The long-awaited comedic love battle fantasy!

(Source: Endless Journey)
synonyms: I've Been Targeted Since Before My Reincarnation!!

title.native: 転生前から狙われてますっ!!

112157.description:
Unrivaled looks, extraordinary skills, a clear path to the throne—Sienna Argent has it all. And now she’s even seeing visions of her future! Everything is set for her as the Silver King and soon-to-be emperor... So why has she suddenly grown wary of those around her? The mother she’s always seen as her ally, the half-royal half-brother she’s constantly shunned, and a man shrouded in mystery, all seem to play a hand in the course of her future. Is Sienna destined for a less than happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.native: #わすれてしまうわたしたち

112164.description:
The sequel to Blood Rain. It follows Lee Jung Woo and Kim Jong Ill.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

112165.description:
Since he was a kid, animal groomer Mamoru has been able to see animals' souls in human form. They haven't ever spoken back, though... until now! One of Mamoru's favorite customers is a tiny chihuahua called "Chappy," who Mamoru sees as a large, perpetually annoyed young man. When his owner gets hospitalized, Mamoru sneaks Chappy into his apartment - only for the tiny dog to turn into a big dude and confess that he's a werewolf!

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes the one-shot "COLOR" and one extra chapter.

title.native: マイ リトル ドギー

112167.description:
An otaku’s idol moves right next to him. And it’s a dream come true! But as it turns out, she’s a bit more sadistic then we expected. Are you seeing a trend here? There is no mercy. Submit to the bully girl of your dreams now.

Note: this is the serialized version published on Comic REX

112169.description:
A sexy, heart-pounding family story between two guys and one girl.

The three of them started living together with the promise of sharing her bed in turn. Why do they have to live together, even though they are childhood friends? Why couldn't she just choose one of the two guys? What does it mean for the three of them to love each other?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

112170.description: Welcome to Divine Realm Online, where victory means everything. Schemes, battles, betrayals, sacrifices, this is not just a game; the price you have to pay is nowhere near what you can possibly imagine...

112171.description:
This manga features Hohoko, a high school student who lives with her musician father. Yahiro, another student who helps in the school library along with Hohoko, is a fan of her father’s group, Hana to Hoho, and realizes who her father is. Hohoko, a book lover, and Yahiro, a music fanatic, write messages to each other in the school library, where private conversation is forbidden, and thereby gradually get to know each other. Hohoko is decidedly drawn to Yahiro, but what he really likes is her father’s music. The fact that he became friends with her because of her father weighs down on her heavily. Gradually, a secret about Hohoko’s mother that her father has kept from her, along with Yahiro’s views on love that result from past trauma, become clear. The two characters’ chance encounter constitutes the story of one summer in their lives, drawn with a touch of tranquility.

(Source: Original publisher, translated)

Note: Won a New Face Award from the 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival in 2020.

112173.description:
“You must fulfil her wish if you want to be reborn.”
What is her wish?
“To be with the star actor!”

(Source: WeComics)

title.english: Reborn to Sleep with a Star Actor

112174.description:
A sudden arrival of letter to her one fine day. By the request of the letter, the witch Bessi Ale returns to her homeland, Veyron Empire after having left it 16 years ago.

After becoming the newly appointed manager of the National Library which was on the brink of closure, she has a premonition that she will be entangled with the secret that's kept hidden in the imperial palace.......

"From now on, I promise to be by your side."

"You are special to me. More special to me than anyone else in the world."

A small spark appears in the curious relationship she has with the knight Justin, who experienced a terrible ill-fated relationship in the past. Amidst all that, Bessi comes closer to revealing the truth that could shake the whole empire.

In the world where only women are able to use magic, shows how the super powerful witch Bessi survives as the manager of the library!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

112178.description: Welcome to the 82nd Precinct, also known as the Crocodile Precinct, which is filled with cops that never let go once they sink their teeth into something. Leading them is Hino Mika, a female cop who's as dangerous as she is beautiful. Follow her on her adventures in this sexy action-suspense series.

112179.description:
A chance encounter between two Tokyo ladies as they are having a terrible day, and reflections on what it means to be a Tokyoite.

Oneshot published in Flowers 2019 Fall issue.

112180.description: The fallen emperor Qin Yun, the inheritance of Jiuyang, awakened the world of martial arts, learned the skills of the world. Since then, he has been on the Xiuwu Avenue. A variety of martial arts strong, in order to seek his refining, willing to serve as his younger brother.

112181.description: In the far future, a meteor falls towards Earth, but suddenly disappears the moment it is about to land. At the same time, world is now covered with monsters and people who starts getting super powers. The world is starting to change and evolve. When Tae Min Park realizes something beyond, he does everything he can to find the truth of freedom.

112182.description: Ah-ju lives two lives, a university student and an exclusive maid for the emperor. When she sleeps in one world, she wakes up in another. One day, the emperor asks her, "Help me with my love!"

112183.description: A spin-off of the High School Fleet series that centers on Miina, the deputy captain of the Admiral Graf Spee.

title.native: ハイスクール・フリート ローレライの乙女たち
title.romaji: High School Fleet: Loreley no Otome-tachi

112185.description:
"A love story about a dark pure love."
Love. Heart. A mistake.
I made a mistake with you----.
Aine Misabashi, a second-year student at a music high school, has secret feelings for her childhood friend Riko Shirota.
When she seeks advice from her close friend Hime (Ayu Yasou), she cannot tell her the feelings she has kept hidden.
In this moment, the girl notices her true heart.
The feelings of youth crumble away, a story about "a dark pure love" starts now----.
The characters' psychological portraits are deep in every way.
A daring yet delicate depiction of a complicated love of boys and girls.

(Source: Manga Club)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

112186.description:
Once upon a time, Shirley, a former noblewoman, lost everything for a crime she did not commit and was exiled from the empire. Now reborn as an immortal, she has become a skilled adventurer, capable of decapitating disaster-level monsters and slicing ancient dragons in half with a single stroke. Her true nature, feared as the "The White Shieldmaiden," is that she is incredibly doting on her children!?

For her beloved twin daughters, Sofie and Tio, even her adventures are no problem! Ogres flee and dragons tremble in this doting adventure fantasy of the strongest sword demon!

(Source: Manga Mirai)
synonyms: Even Though I’m a Former Noble and a Single Mother, My Daughters Are Too Cute and Working as an Adventurer Isn’t Too Much of a Hassle

112187.description: Sunny has a peculiar ability: wherever he is, there’s always clear skies and sunshine. One day on his travels he comes across the girl Raine, whose ability is the exact opposite of his. This is the whimsical tale of Sunny, Raine, and their feline companion Polkadot as they journey to find the floating island Final Rest and return home a special little sapling. And maybe, along the way, a place where they belong.
synonyms: Raine and Sunny's Journey of Wind
Ame and Hare's Journey of Wind

title.romaji: Ame to Hare no Kaze no Tabi

112188.description:
Sayako has been in a relationship with Naohiko for 10 years, but the passion of love faded since long and their couple starts to slowly crumble. But one day, Sayako finds in the street a stair that she never saw before. Taking it she comes back 10 years in the past, when Naohiko was still a teenager, in a world where her teen self doesn't exist.

This is the start of a strange love-triangle between Sayako, Naohiko as an adult and Naohiko as a teenager.
synonyms: You In the Past, You in the Future

title.native: 過去のあなた、未来のきみ
title.romaji: Kako no Anata, Mirai no Kimi

112189.description:
A new discovered 10th planet, called Lametal, will collide with earth on 9th September 1999. While the impact won't affect the giant ice planet critically, earth will be destroyed.
Yayoi, daughter of Lametal's queen and entrusted with the mission to abduct a large number of humans for slavery, befriends the orphaned boy Hajime and starts to question the intentions of her mother. Together with her human family and friends, she takes up the fight against Lametal and searches for a way to avoid earth's destruction.

112191.description:
He met a beauty on the beach and had a passionate night with her. But it turns out that she was actually his friend's mom! A tale of deception, mystery, and shocking truth. What is really going on? Is anyone who they actually claim to be?

(Source: DAYcomics)

112192.description:
Jaime is looking for someone serious. Not like those cheap girls. Someone like his neighbor...

(Source: Toomics)

112193.description:
I casually joined an online club, but there's something covert and sexual about it. Somehow we're all connected to one another. Meet my "secret" neighbors!

(Source: Toomics)

112194.description: Jae-Won has avoided dating after having a bad experience with relationships. But everything changes when he meets his childhood friend...

112195.description:
Mike gets a headache and sees a girl every single time he's with his girlfriend. Will he be able to find the cure for it?

(Source: Toomics)

112196.description:
A relationship that wasn't allowed...Even if we're not related by blood is it ok for two "siblings" to be together? No matter what society says...I still love you. A heartwarming tale of betrayal, lust, and whether it's ok to follow your heart.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

112197.description:
Kim Jihyun, who lived his life as a disreputable surgeon, gains a second chance to relive his life. He then goes back to his middle school days, and live his life to the fullest unlike before, he studies nonstop. His goal is to become a dermatologist who make lots of money instead of the poor surgeon he was from previous life!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: リターン～ある外科医の逆襲～

112198.description:
"If you expose our secret, I shall kill you."

After an accident on a mountain, Takatou is helped by Ritsu, a woman with a red birthmark under her right eye.

"If consumed, they become an elixir."

Having learnt the legend of the Red Leopard, Takatou seems to become obsessed and continues to search for Ritsu. Thus begins the love romance of these two trapped in a legend.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: 赤豹のサンクチュアリ

title.native: 赤豹のサンクチュアリ

112199.description: Story about Magata Shiki, a character from S&M series.

112200.description: Note: Originally published in the anthology L Girls -Love Girls- 01.

112201.description:
Yoshino Michi is 32 years old. She's been married for five years, but hasn't had sex for the last two. It's not as if she doesn't get along with her husband, it's just that the sex part is lacking. It was a bit unexpected, but one night when she when drinking with her colleague, Niina Makoto (36), she wound up confessing that her marriage had turned sexless. And then, a shocked Niina responded "My marriage is sexless, too," and smiled with a lonely look in her eyes.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Even If You Don't Do It
title.native: あなたがしてくれなくても
僕らは自分のことばかり
title.romaji: Bokura wa Jibun no Koto bakari

112203.description:
For ages, humanity flourished through the power of magic, a gift from witches to aid mankind. But times have changed. The scientific Gear Expansion has made both magic and witches obsolete. In order to liberate humanity from the blight of magic, the mighty Redia Empire began a ruthless hunt to exterminate all witches. Adonis was only a boy when the hunt began, apprentice to a witch he dearly loved. When she perishes at the hands of the empire, Adonis vows revenge. By this furious wizard’s power, blood will flow!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

112204.description:
30 years have passed since the beginning of the great war between the people of "Jade" and "Kokuyou", which ended with Kokuyo as the winners and the losers of Jade becoming their slaves. And now the emperor has decided to perform a gladiator's tournament called "Shaba Juu Rengoku", and has proclaimed that the tournament's winner will receive the title of "Shaba-ou" and also the emperor's throne. Meanwhile, a certain one-eyed swordsman​ has become popular among the gladiators...

This is the story of a one-eyed slave aiming to become emperor!

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: てんてんてんかちゃん
先輩、パンツはいてますか？

112209.description:
A school just like any other in a town just like any other. A teacher just like any other and a mother just like any other. This was supposed to be a normal parent-teacher relationship just like any other... Until that nightmare of a "home visit" happened. What begins as a "corporal punishment incident" in a quiet town rapidly captures national attention, spiraling into a full-blown trial. With the eyes of the nation watching, the hammer of justice appears ready to strike its decisive blow...

Note: Manga adaption of Masami Fukuda's nonfiction novel, serialized on Monthly Comic Bunch.

112210.description: Prequel to Tokimeki Tonight, focusing on Mouri and Shira Etou's past.

title.native: ときめきトゥナイト 江藤望里の駆け落ち

112214.description: A young lady of the prime minister family, enduring for 8 years. Finally, at one day she was bestowed empress, Phoenix of the country! But life is unpredictable. Her husband loved her stepsister, deposed her as Empress and even forced her son into death. In that Cold Palace, she was forced to drink poisonous wine. So in the next lifetime, she made a promise to never do good deeds and help others, to never step into the palace and to never become the Empress!

112216.description:
In the country of Larvata, mages are oppressed and seen as filthy beings. Leon is a talented but rather weak mage. Zechs is an orphan boy with great innate magical talent. Their meeting will change their lives as well as the world around them.

Note: Chapter count includes four special chapters.

112217.description:
"--This dungeon is useless!"
One day, Ichi Monster Nargoa is appointed as the middle boss of the first dungeon "Shijima Cave" closest to the hero's home base.
There were only unconscious employees (monsters), and Nargoa started a major reform of the dungeon when this was not enough, but it was worth the effort, and even one year after taking office, Shijima's cave was rejected even by a mid-level brave party Transformed into a great labyrinth!
However, the legendary heroes who have already defeated the Demon King, Nargoa challenged and defeated the single heroes to protect their beloved employees, and-somehow reincarnated in the world 100 years later. I will!
In the world 100 years later, a thrilling boss fantasy unfolds with the employees of the Shijima Cave, which has become a legendary labyrinth! Opening here!
synonyms: Nakabosu-san reberu 99, saikyou no buka-tachi to tomoni ni Shū-me totsunyū!

title.romaji: Nakabosu-san Level 99, Saikyou no Bukatachi to Tomo ni Nishuume Totsunyuu!

112218.description:
The 4th arc of the Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu manga.

On to the next stage: the witch’s tomb known as the Sanctuary- Determined to release Rem from a mysterious slumber, Subaru and Emilia return to Roswaal’s manor in search of clues on how to reach the Sanctuary, the secret location to which Ram and Roswaal escaped. But the way there is fraught with the unexpected-especially for Subaru, who finds himself in the company of a curious figure. A new chapter begins, and with it, a new adventure…

(Source: Yen Press)

112220.description: When the Duke's Daughter Alice was five years old, she realized that her world is exactly like that of a particular otome game. As far as she's concerned, this world where magic and magical beasts are commonplace is paradise?! With good-looking boys and fluffy beasts all around, not to mention her cute school friends and dangerous rivals... what more of a dramatic isekai school life could Alice ask for?
synonyms: Reincarnated into an Otome Game? Who Cares! I’m Too Busy Mastering Magic!
Reincarnated into an Otome Game? Nah, I'm Too Busy Mastering Magic!

title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Otomege no Sekai? Ie, Majutsu wo Kiwameru no ni Isogashii node Souiu no wa Kekkou desu.

112221.description:
The manga centers on 16-year-old Taiya, who lives in a share house with a 26-year-old caretaker named Ren, who loves bicycles in her private time. Taiya sees Ren as a goddess who is an expert in cleaning, laundry, and cooking, but also enjoys the sight of Ren fawning over his bicycle.

(Source: Anime News Network)

112222.description:
Meet Setsuna. She’s cute, sexy, and deadly. When she’s not out murdering people as a professional assassin, she’s nesting at home, trying to adjust to a domestic life with her new husband. She skewers ingredients for dinner, draws a knife on unwanted solicitors, and sleeps with one eye open, just in case enemies sneak in. Her lovestruck husband doesn’t ask her a lot of questions about her day job, so this arrangement can work if love conquers all, right? This romantic comedy is dangerously sexy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Dear Sir... I Married a Killer
敬啟者：我與殺手小姐結婚了

title.english: My Lovey-Dovey Wife is a Stone Cold Killer
title.native: 拝啓…殺し屋さんと結婚しました

112223.description: Mamori Kurisaka is a college student who has recently started living alone in Tokyo after entering university. She secretly admires the handsome designer, Yoji Asagata, who lives in the room next door. After Mamori finds some unsettling documents in her mailbox, the two became closer and she found herself seeking haven in his mini-vegetable garden on the veranda!

112225.description:
A serious girl and lethargic boy's youthful, pure love starts!! One is methodical and serious, while the other is lethargic but can do anything...!? Meet the regrettable prince, Miyano-kun. A story about two people who never seem to cross.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

112228.description:
Sanda Shinichi has just got a new job, and the company that hired him has an unusual system: the new hires choose their own boss. To his surprise, all four of his potential bosses are women, and they're all really cute! Unable to decide which one to pick, he ends up working for all of them until he can make his choice.

Includes 3 extra chapters.

112229.description: Manatsu Morisaki (18) received a love confession from her teacher Shinobu (26) when she graduated from high school. He proposed to her and then they got married with 0 days of dating. Former teacher Shinobu continues to treat Manatsu as a child even after they are married. But Manatsu wants to be touched and accepted as a wife...!?

112232.description:
The story is about a country bumpkin boy who has moved to the big city. But soon after he struggles financially, loses his job. Then he meets a porn producer who wants to hire him for his huge dick. The problem is the boy's still a virgin.

(Source: Manga Mogura)
synonyms: มิลเลี่ยนดอลล่าดิกเกอร์

title.native: ミリオンダラーディガー

112234.description:
Nina had a rough start to life, stealing to survive—and eventually being sold into slavery by her own brother. But to her surprise, her captor, Prince Azure, ordained that she would live the life of a princess...specifically, that of the recently deceased princess-priestess, Alisha. But despite her changing fortune, Nina won't give up her old life without a fight...and Azure might just be the one to finally match her wits. But how much can she trust Azure? And can she stop the feelings budding in her heart, knowing she must eventually marry another...?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Won the 46th Annual Kodansha Manga Award for Best Shoujo Manga.
synonyms: Nina del reino de las estrellas
Nina – Die Sterne sind dein Schicksal

112235.description:
Momose is an ordinary college student who harbors two secrets. The first is that, despite posting lots of sweet and sugary foods onto her social media, she actually hates them and wants to eat more fatty, rich meals. And the second is...

Note: Chapter count includes 23 regular chapters and 1 extra.

112236.description: Ryohei just graduated from high school. He visits a secret spot he's frequented since childhood. There, he meets a bubbly girl who knows him. And he does too, under the Sakura petals.

112238.description:
Ren Jiang are able to extract bones, modify tissue, and remodel the body. They can heal illnesses or create chaos. Cheng Shan has this unique ability and leaves home at the age of 16 to venture into the city.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

112239.description: About a Boy and a Girl Who Aren't Good at Love
synonyms: About a Boy Who Isn't Good at Love
About a Girl Who Isn't Good at Love

title.native: バレンタインデーとホワイトデー

112241.description: Due to a mistake on his student’s part, a super Martial Artist received the wrong class in an online game and has become a mage. He, who was used to curbing violence with violence and using strength to subdue strength, could only make the best out of this mistake. Taking on a new lease in life, he became a violent close combat mage. When strength and magic came perfectly together, a new gaming path had been opened by him!

112242.description:
The Prince believed all of that woman’s lies and broke off his engagement with me. Even when I cried and begged for them to stop, that woman’s hired thugs came after me. As she saw all these tragedies happening to me that woman, my sister, sweetly smiled…

A year later, I was reborn as her daughter. Keeping both the memory and burning vendetta from my previous life, I had been given a second chance. I cast aside the weak person I was before in order to prepare for my counterattack. That was the only way I could crush all of my enemies.

…Now, it’s time to begin. I shall have my revenge on that woman.
synonyms: The Splendid Daily Life of the Mother Devouring Princess

title.native: 母喰い王女の華麗なる日々
title.romaji: Haha Kui Oujo no Kareinaru Hibi

112243.description:
The story begins with the marriage of Qing Wu and Jing Yu.
At the end of the ceremony, Li Huo arrives, pretending to be Qing Wu's husband.
To understand the situation, let's go back 20 years, the day Qing Wu was sent to find work by her adoptive mother, deeming her too lazy.
She returns hired as a sky sweeper for Jing Yu ... but wouldn't she have other hidden talents ...?

(Source: QQ, translated)

112244.description: There are some heroes whose names you do not know, whose faces you have not seen... They operate secretly, and their actions can make a difference in the outcomes of wars. Biheun is the story of such a man. To follow his story, one must search in the shadows, for that is the only place you could find him...

112245.description:
A collection of short stories:

The Distant Dawn - Weekly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1975 Issue 34
The Steel Queen - Weekly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1975 April 28th Extra Edition
Escape from the Wastelands - Weekly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1975 Issue 39
Funeral Convoy - Monthly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1976 March
A Call from Afar - Weekly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1978 September 15th Extra Edition
Whiteout - Weekly Manga Action (Futabasha) 1979 Super Fiction August 31 Extra Edition
Amazons of the River - Weekly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1977 September 10th Extra Edition
The Carneades Plan - Weekly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1976 August 20th Extra Edition
Algae (Part 1) - Monthly Bears’ Club (Shueisha) 1990 August
Algae (Part 2) - Monthly Bears’ Club (Shueisha) 1990 September
Lightning Strike - Monthly Shounen Jump (Shueisha) 1975 August
Emperor of Winter - Young Magazine (Kodansha) 1996 July
One Day In The Life of Ivan Dejavu - Business Jump (Shueisha) 1986 March
Alice (Part 1) - Comic Tom (Shio Shuppansha) 1985 August
Alice (Part 2) - Comic Tom (Shio Shuppansha) 1985 September
Alice (Part 3) - Comic Tom (Shio Shuppansha) 1985 October

112246.description: Note: Originally published in the anthology L Girls -Love Girls- 03.

112247.description: Note: Originally published in the anthology L Girls -Love Girls- 02.

112248.description: Note: Originally published in the anthology L Girls -Love Girls- 04.

112249.description: Note: Originally published in the anthology L Girls -Love Girls- 05.

title.native: とばりアディクション

112250.description:
1-3. Muramata-san no Himitsu (村又さんの秘密, Muramata-san's Secret); Comic Hotmilk 2019-01, 07, 10
Muramata-san is the local senpai at our main character's office. She's fun and cheerful, but she also has a big secret?

4. Sobaya no Haru-san (蕎麦屋の春さん, The Soba Restaurant's Haru-san); Comic Hotmilk 2019-03
5. Momose wa Shiru (百瀬は知る); Comic Hotmilk 2018-11
6. Backstage (バックステージ); Comic Hotmilk 2014-12
7. Ame yo Muchi yo, Yumi to Gen (飴よ鞭よ、弓と弦); Comic Hotmilk 2014-06
8. Marching (MARCHING！); Comic Hotmilk 2014-04
synonyms: Ame yo Muchi yo, Yumi to Gen

112251.description:
Late at night in the middle of my part time job at a convenience store, I was mercilessly stabbed to death by a robber.

As I was about to lose my consciousness, I thought about how many things I still wanted to do, and that when I heard a voice……

"The wish to be summoned has been confirmed. Granting Unique Skill, 'Jack of all Trades, Master of None'."

What kind of skill is that, Jack of All Trades, Master of None? Don’t screw with me!

Such thoughts and wishes were for naught as my consciousness faded, when I came too I was standing on a green foggy hill.
synonyms: I Came to Another World as a Jack of All Trades and a Master of None to Journey while Relying on Quickness

title.native: 異世界に来た僕は器用貧乏で素早さ頼りな旅をする
title.romaji: Isekai ni Kita Boku wa Kiyoubinbode Subayasa Tayorina Tabi wo Suru

title.native: 魅惑のタピオカミルクティー

112253.description:
An adventure in another world with cute girls by your side and video game-like powers–sounds like an anime fan’s dream, right? Not so for melancholic author Osamu Dazai, who would quite literally prefer to drop dead. Video games haven’t even been invented yet when he gets yanked into another world in 1948. Really, all the fantastical adventure he keeps running into is just getting in the way of his poetic dream of finding the perfect place to die. But no matter how much he risks his hide, everything seems to keep turning out okay. Follow a miserable hero like no other in this cheerfully bleak isekai comedy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.
synonyms: สูญสิ้นที่ต่างโลก

title.english: No Longer Allowed In Another World

112254.description:
First Volume: Emori Kunihiko gets depressed when his girlfriend breaks up with him. Then a random stranger goes out of his way to be friendly, and Emori responds with resentment and resistance. (Included in the first volume are two oneshots unrelated to the main story, about a salaryman's relationship with a pair of twins.)

Final Volume: Dragged out of his shell into new adventures by the outgoing Makishima Atsushi, Emori finds himself enjoying life for the first time in a long time. If only Emori could make Makishima listen to him.

112255.description:
The 170cm tall Sora has fallen in love with the shortest boy in her grade, Hikaru. He's 150cm tall... meaning there's a 20cm height difference!!! But that obstacle doesn't matter! Sora tries hard to impress him by wearing a new miniskirt and becoming the manager of the basketball club he belongs to, but it's no use for the super insensitive Hikaru...! 20cm is a bigger hurdle than she could have imagined! How can she get Hikaru to notice her?!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: ちっ恋！ ～空ちゃんと光くんの20cm差の恋～
title.romaji: Chikkoi! Sora-chan to Kou-kun no 20 cm Sa no Koi

112256.description:
Anima is an immensely powerful Demon Lord, so he spends his days living in solitude...right up until he’s summoned to another world out of the blue! The person who summons him is Luina, a poor girl who has her hands full running an orphanage. Anima quickly falls for her and, in a first for him, learns what it’s like to be surrounded by loved ones. With Luina by his side, the detestable Demon Lord now vows only to use his fearsome powers to protect his newfound family!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Why Shouldn’t a Detestable Demon Lord Fall in Love?!
title.native: 嫌われ魔王が没落令嬢と恋に落ちて何が悪い！
title.romaji: Kiraware Maou ga Botsuraku Reijou to Koi ni Ochite Nani ga Warui!

112257.description:
"There's this pub (Izakaya) that was supposed to be in a certain place in Kanto region of Japan called “Gen”.
After opening the door one day, it was found to be connected to the city of Parisia, the Kingdom of the Eastern Kingdom…
Individual residents from a foreign world such as fallen monks, warriors, noble female knight, daughters of noisy famous aristocrats, etc. all visited the peculiar izakaya which they've never seen before, and gradually they'll become fans of the dishes…
A foreign world gourmet fantasy has finally started!"

112259.description:
Beautiful x clumsy = Moe #1 ♪

To be honest, I think I’m pretty popular. But I don’t really know much about love and thought that girls were all the same… That was until I met you. While being with you I end up looking like a fool. If it were other girls, I could easily sweet-talk them anytime, but in front of you, my mind goes blank. Real love sure is on a completely different level…

Reading this, you’ll feel all warm and cosy and your heart will beat for them ♪ At the time of serialization, there were casualties en masse because of this cuteness!

112260.description:
This is the story of two lovers, Jae Moon and Ji Yeon, fated for each other as a dragon is to its pearl. Their love overcame the barrier of hierarchy, but the star-crossed lovers were torn apart when one of them was killed in a tragic incident.

The reincarnated Jae Moon and Ji Yeon are reunited once again in the present time. With such a tragedy in their past lives, will the two be able to rekindle the feelings they had for each other from a happier past?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 10 extras.

112261.description:
Jiang Chen crossed into the judgment day after the nuclear war, and there was a mess everywhere. In order to survive, Jiang Chen led the refugees to establish a base area and set up a federation. Then carry the judgment day's technology and return to the true world. Change the political structure of the earth, rescue the world in a critical moment, and establish the Great Union of Earth Federation! Expanding the territory and fighting the threat from the sky.

(source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I have a suite in the last days

title.english: I Have a Mansion in the Post-Apocalyptic World

112262.description:
Collection of short stories:

1) Nanairo Contrast (なないろコントラスト)

2) Sweet Bitter Room (スウィート・ビタールーム)
Shiroi Kaname, a second year in high school, my parents have been deployed to work overseas. I was going to stay alone in a single room in a shared house but...

3) Kono Kekkon ni wa "Suki" ga Nai (この結婚には"スキ"がない, There Is No Love in This Marriage)
Right before the wedding ceremony... something happens to the groom?! Would you love someone who has changed? Tomoka and her boyfriend You are going to be married! As they exchange their vows, You proclaims "I don't". Surprised, Tomoka just found out that You doesn't remember her at all! What will Tomoka do? Will You ever remember her?

4) Fushigi no Heya no Ouji-sama (不思議の部屋の王子様)
A lonely girl lends her umbrella to a dog on a rainy day. The next day a boy comes to return the favour. Is this boy the dog from yesterday?

5) Koakuma no Jikku! (小悪魔じっく！, Koakumagic!)
Himari is a beautiful model that is a little too honest, and therefore making her friendless. She only wishes that she had friends that can like her for who she is. One day she meets a cute boy and as per usual, became a bit too honest with him. Himari was surprised that he seems to not mind her blunt opinion of him. She is even more surprised when she sees him while she is in a photoshoot...

(Source: Chibi Manga & Shoujo Sense)
synonyms: Kono Kekkon ni wa Suki ga nai
There Is No Love in This Marriage

title.native: スウィート・ビタールーム

112263.description:
Jihoon is confident that he can easily make guys, even straight ones, fall for him. It worked quite well up until he met Gyungwoo.

Jihoon works as a nude model and is introduced to Gyungwoo for his personal photograph project. Gyungwoo appears nonchalant to Jihoon's looks, deeply hurting his pride.
Now, Jihoon is determined to make Gyungwoo fall for him.

(Source: Netcomics)

112265.description:
Bo-Mi is the prettiest girl in school, and she wants to live at my house! Has springtime finally come for me at last?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

112266.description:
"Shinseiki Chuugakusei Nikki will focus on the four Neon Genesis Junior High Students and their everyday lives as they chase after cats, buy groceries, and eat nabe together."

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Neon Genesis Junior High Students Diary

title.native: SSSS.GRIDMAN 新世紀中学生日記

112267.description:
"Hime to Samurai will center on Samurai Calibur, and a girl named Hime Kuzuki, who has been entrusted with Calibur's fifth sword."

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

112268.description: Kaori is secretly in love with her brother-in-law. When her sister wants a divorce, she senses her chance - because Yuzuki is not only married to the painter Ryoichi, she was always his muse. Without further ado, Kaori offers himself as a new model. However, he has quite different games with her in mind ...

112269.description: "I'll teach you how to be a bad girl." As a high schooler, Ayumu's at a sensitive period in her life. She ends up being educated on adult matters by a bearded old man wearing a black t-shirt.
synonyms: 叔叔教女●中生做壞壞的事
叔叔教女●中生做坏坏的事
아저씨가 여고생에게 나쁜 짓을 알려주는 이야기
A Story About an Old Man Teaches Bad Things to a School Girl

title.native: おじさんが女子●生に悪いことを教える話
title.romaji: Oji-san ga Joshi●sei ni Warui Koto wo Oshieru Hanashi

112271.description: "All I wanted was simply for it to be just the two of us, yet..." Senri is young man who can hear the voices of plants, an envoy of the gods. As a watchman for the gods of heaven and earth, his role is to cut down the gods that have been made impure, returning them to heaven where they will be reincarnated. He travels with a kitsune named Shino all for the sake of undoing the curse of the one he loves.

title.native: 時給900円で家族演（や）ってます

112273.description:
Dennis is one of the most popular members of the Silverwing Battalion, the world's strongest party. So popular, in fact, that the party leader expels him from the group out of spite.

Stripped of his home, Dennis decides to start life anew following his true calling—as a chef! His life as an adventurer might be over, but his new life as a cook is just beginning. He teams up with Atelier, a young girl who has been similarly exiled from her home, and opens up a restaurant for adventurers.

He's finally able to live out his dream, but he'll need use of more than just his cooking skills to take care of his eclectic customers' problems!

(Source: Kaiten Books)
synonyms: Welcome to the Diner of the Exiled!
Welcome to the Cheap Restaurant of Outcasts!

title.native: 追放者食堂へようこそ！ ～最強パーティーを追放された料理人（Lv.99）は、田舎で念願の冒険者食堂を開きます！～
title.romaji: Tsuihousha Shokudou e Youkoso!: Saikyou Party wo Tsuihousareta Ryourinin (Lv. 99) wa, Inaka de Nengan no Boukensha Shokudou wo Hirakimasu!

112274.description:
Entering high school, Fujimura Kotone dreams of making friends and finding love. However, her classmates avoid her because of her scary demeanor. One day, a group made up of two girls and a boy come into her class and kneel before her, proclaiming, "It's an honor to meet you, Demon Lord!". With their antics, will she be able to obtain the normal love life she desires?

A reincarnation romantic comedy that transcends space and time!
synonyms: The Demon Lord's Love Life Isn't Going Well

112275.description:
800 years ago, Xie Lian was a pure-blooded and noble Crown Prince, a well-regarded child of Heaven with unlimited potential. But who knew that, after he ascended and became a god with tens of thousands of worshippers, his fate would take such a sharp downhill turn? He was demoted again and again, and fell to rock bottom. 800 years later, Xie Lian ascended again, but this time, without worshippers or and without incense. One day, after returning from collecting scraps, he took a mysterious young man home. And this young man was the Ghost King that made others pale in fear whenever discussed—Hua Cheng.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: สวรรค์ประทานพร

112276.description:
Cyrus, the warrior of the eastern country, was busy responding to the "other world hero" summoned by the enemy country every day. However, Cyrus rejects various heroes with great power.

He had a secret; it is the existence of "Ranobe", the information source of the hero of another world that only he knows.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 軍師様は異世界勇者が気に入らない‐ラノベの知識でチート封じ‐
title.romaji: Gunshi-sama wa Isekai Yuusha ga Kiniiranai: Ranobe no Chishiki de Cheat Fuuji

112277.description: The story of a girl who likes to poke various things, including the boy sitting next to her.

112278.description: Year 20xx. In various parts of the world, there are gates that connect to another world. There are tens of thousands of demi-humans and monsters living in Tokyo alone and various services have been established to accommodate the residents from the other world. One such place is the real estate agency called Ebisu-ya.

112279.description:
Miyoi works at Geidontei, a izakaya pub in a remote part of the fantasy land, Gensokyo. As a postergirl, she is worried that there is a rumor that some of their customers have disappeared, and that ghoul had kidnapped them. Reimu, a priestess of Hakurei Shrine, sets out to investigate the case--what is behind all this?

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: Touhou Suichouka: Intoxication and Detoxication of the Lotus Eaters
Touhou Suichouka: Drunkening and Sobering of Lotus-Eaters

title.english: The Lotus Eaters, Drunk and Sober
title.native: 東方酔蝶華 ロータスイーターたちの酔醒
title.romaji: Touhou Suichouka: Lotus Eater-tachi no Suisei

112280.description:
When he woke up, he found himself restrained by a junior classmate, who was holding a whip and a stun gun. A torturous comedy with a crazy kouhai girl!

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

title.native: それじゃ、拷問はじめま～す！

112281.description:
1965, Japan. At that time, manga was still considered a pastime for children. But in a small publishing house located on the upper floor of a shabby wooden building, a group of men gathered to try to create a new type of manga. 
Fumito “Bunjin” Shimizu, editor-in-chief of Manga Story magazine, fished the first issue of an amateur fanzine out of the trash. 
One of its creators, Kazuhiko Katou, would later become known by the pseudonym “Monkey Punch”... And so destiny took its course!
synonyms: Losers: Nipponhatsu no shuukan seinen mangashi no tanjou

title.native: ルーザーズ～日本初の週刊青年漫画誌の誕生～
title.romaji: Losers: Nihon Hatsu no Shuukan Seinen Manga-shi no Tanjou

112283.description:
A 30 something Margaret was summoned to a different world as a special being called “Spirit Orison”. However, what was waiting there was a rural life in the countryside, which was the complete opposite of her previous life. Meeting a gentle old lady, we will start a cheerful and delicious slow life surrounded by warm people.

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: Simmering Jams at the Edge of the Forest

title.native: 森のほとりでジャムを煮る ～異世界ではじめる田舎暮らし～
title.romaji: Mori no Hotori de Jam wo Niru: Isekai de Hajimeru Inakagurashi

112288.description:
Two short stories by Shimamizu Eke.

1. Reverie in a Deserted Bus
Yoshiharu lost her only skill, the ability to play the piano, because of stress caused from the immense pressure her parents put on her. In her despair, she tries to jump off a rooftop. Suddenly, a ghost appears and introduces herself as Yume. Yume invites Yoshiharu to her "secret base", an abandoned bus. Yoshiharu decides to throw away the piano, her parents, everything, and follows Yume to her secret base. There, she comes to face Yume's past. "Let's remain children like this forever"

2. Kimi no Itami wo Kizamu Basho
The smiling face of her childhood friend. The emotionless girl wishes for her to keep smiling in their normal everyday together.

Note: Released at COMITIA 120.
synonyms: Kimi no itami wo kizamu basho

title.romaji: Hai Bus no Naka no Yume

112289.description:
Centered around two rookie inspectors of the Ministry of Welfare's Public Safety Bureau (MWPSB); Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov. These two inspectors are confronted with an ever changing society under the jurisdiction of the all knowing and impartial system of collective consciousness known as Sibyl and a contradiction that exists solely to evince the imperfections of the Sibyl system. Contending with an increasing anti immigrant sentiment, political intrigue, as well as peculiar individuals who exist solely to test the Sibyl system, these two inspectors are confronted with two choices, which are to either follow or overturn the system.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ころしたのはきみじゃない

112291.description: One day, high school student Kakeru had met the end of his life in a traffic accident. But he noticed he was reincarnated into a fantasy world. Moreover, it was a village full of shota without women and adults!
synonyms: After Reincarnation, My Party Was Full of Traps, but I'm Not a Shotacon!

title.native: 転生したらパーティが男の子だらけだったけど断じて俺はショタコンじゃない!
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Party ga Otokonoko Darake datta kedo Danjite Ore wa Shotacon Janai!

112292.description:
A collection of one shots:

1. Kagarigari (過狩り狩り)
2. Monju Shirou Kyoudai (文殊史郎兄弟)
3. Rokkotsu-san (肋骨さん)
4. Haeniwa no Zigzag (蠅庭のジグザグ)

title.english: Koyoharu Gotouge Before Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba

112297.description:
The story is set in England. Malissa and Isadora are sisters in a poor family. One day, Isadora gets to know Malissa is a daughter of a noble family, who are searching for the missing daughter.
Isadora lies she is the missing daughter to get a castle and all the asset of the family instead of Malissa. After getting into the family, Isadora plans to get married to a crown prince in a foreign country. On the other hand, some people doubt Isadora is the missing daughter.
Malissa ends up getting to know she is the real daughter.

Note: Won the 1970 Shogakukan Manga Award.

112298.description:
Second volume of Uchida Yoshimi Masterpiece Collection with:

1. Aki no Owari no Pianissimo (秋のおわりのピアニシモ); Ribon Deluxe Autumn 1976
2. Nami no Shougaibutsu Race (なみの障害物レース); Ribon 1974-07
3. Cabbage Batake ni Hoshi ga Furi (キャベツ畑に星が降り); Ribon 1975-06
4. Ginga Sono Hoshigari (銀河 その星狩り); Ribon Deluxe Autumn 1977
synonyms: Cabbage Hatake ni Hoshi ga Furi

title.native: 秋のおわりのピアニシモ

112299.description:
Yuina and Maya have been friends since kindergarten. They both like each other, but...?

Note: The main story has 61 chapters, but the book includes 3 other short stories inside it.
Kamai Kamaware Yuri Shimai (12 chapters)
Ano Futari to Yuri Shimai (5 chapters)
Chiisana Yuri no Hanashi (15 chapters)

112304.description:
Nega Shouya and Hoshi Sayaka are high school classmates. Nega is tremendously pessimistic, while Hoshi is optimistic, both to a fault. They also happen to be deeply in love with each other, but they completely misread each other's cues, him erring by defect, and her erring by excess. The fundamental law of magnetism states that opposites attract, and these two starkly different young lovers are not the exception!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

title.native: ネガくんとポジちゃん

112309.description:
Love-beginner Wau suddenly finds herself in the world of an otome game! And she can't go back until she finds true love with one of the game characters!? The standoffish Mizuki, sexy Ichika, cute Mitsumu, and gentle Tou... Who would you choose?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: ロックアッププリンス

112310.description:
High school girl Azuki Ariune ran away from home, determined to live a homeless life! But there was going to be a lot of pitfalls and challenges in her way. That was she met the older girl Kana Kadomu, and Kana's mysterious street smarts will help Azuki start her new life. An extraordinary story DIY street-life begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

112311.description: Having lost his confidence as a bread-maker, Masaki works making bread in a bakery and boarding house run by a pair of sisters in Otaru, Hokkaido. Seeing the smiles on the people eating the bread, he grows to maturity one step at a time as a maker of breads.

112313.description:
Do you believe in love at first sight?

Paul Auster doesn't. Paul doesn't believe in much at all. He’s thirty, slightly overweight, and his best features are his acerbic wit and the color commentary he provides as life passes him by. He works a dead-end job in a soul-sucking cubicle, and his closest friends are a quasibipolar drag queen named Helena Handbasket and a two-legged dog named Wheels. Enter Vince Taylor. Vince is everything Paul isn’t: hot, sexy, and confident. And for some reason, Vince pursues Paul relentlessly. Vince must be messing with him, because there is no way Vince could want someone like Paul. But when Paul hits Vince with his car—in a completely unintentional if-he-died-it'd-only-be-manslaughter kind of way—he's forced to see Vince in a whole new light. The only thing stopping Paul from believing in Vince is himself—and that is one obstacle Paul can’t quite seem to overcome. But when tragedy strikes Vince's family, Paul must put aside any notions he has about himself and stand next to the man who thinks he's perfect the way he is.

(Source: Dream Spinner)

112314.description: A story that begins with the encounter between Arti, a famous female college student known for her video streaming, and Shuro, a plain girl with a passion for photography.

112315.description: As a patron saint, he just made a difference. How did he become the president of the student union and became the thorn in the eyes of the guardian? It’s just a routine business to help her resolve the crisis, but she is used to the second middle of her illness. Seeing that the misunderstanding is getting deeper and deeper, her condition is getting heavier and heavier.

title.romaji: Wo De Chouren You Chao Nengli

112316.description: Acting pretentious is his hobby! Being the ultimate rich player, he’s used to spending “expenses” around others on the down-low, having the most extravagant equipment and armor. In the gaming world, there's nothing that can't be solved with money!

112317.description:
After witnessing a mob hit, surgeon Jack Francisco is put into protective custody to keep him safe until he can testify. A hitman known only as D is blackmailed into killing Jack, but when he tracks him down, his weary conscience won't allow him to murder an innocent man. Finding in each other an unlikely ally, Jack and D are soon on the run from shadowy enemies.

Forced to work together to survive, the two men forge a bond that ripens into unexpected passion. Jack sees the wounded soul beneath D's cold, detached exterior, and D finds in Jack the person who can help him reclaim the man he once was. As the day of Jack's testimony approaches, he and D find themselves not only fighting for their lives... but also fighting for their future. A future together.

(Source: Dreamspinner Press)

112318.description:
Bookstore owner, Otani Mitsunobu, is a scary man. That is, to the people of the Komacchi Shopping District. Then one day...

He ends up taking care of a child that came from heaven and was sent by God?! And why is everyone suddenly not scared of him anymore?

112319.description:
Ye Wen crossed and became the lord of asect! It seems to be good, but this asect art seems to be a little weaker, and people are less... "Senior, the master said, the responsibility of revitalizing the faction will be handed over to you!" The only fellow sister said with a look: " If you can't do it, give me the position of the head!"

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Top Clan Leader In History

112320.description:
Chen Fei, one of the five Great Immortals, was on the verge of death when he burnt up a godly artifact in order to return to when he was 18 years old. His girlfriend's betrayal, his friend's selling out, the bullying from his family... all the regrets on his road towards immortality. This time he will not just take it, he will not run away, and he will not give up. This time, he will be the strongest in the city!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: シンエンレジスト CURE

Fives stories originally published in Manga Grimm Douwa:

1. Shinoda Tsuma (しのだ妻); 2007-07
2. Adabana Aku-no-Hana (仇花　悪の花); 2009-04
3. Kibitsu no Kama (吉備津の釜); 2009-07

5. Majo no Tettsui (魔女の鉄槌); 2009-11

title.native: 仇花 悪の花鬼女・妖婦伝

112326.description:
“I’ll wait for you,” whispers a mysterious, red-haired woman. So goes the recurring dream Jae-Sin Yang has had every night since the tragic massacre at the orphanage when he was a child. When he moves to the notoriously haunted Orchid Road to delve into the meaning behind his dreams, he is nearly killed by a vengeful demon on the first night. However, he is rescued by a beautiful woman named So-Cheon who looks just like the woman in his dreams. Together, they join forces to help innocent demons and fight against the demonic designs of Geumgwan, the lord of all demons.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Includes a prologue.

112327.description:
A high school student starts a baseball team with the goal of eventually playing at Koshien Stadium.

Notes:
- Includes the two part story "Emerald Cave: Hebi no Tani (Emerald Cave―蛇の谷―)"

112328.description:
When the demonic races from the great beyond invaded the Great Qian once again, mighty heroes such as High Priest Mu Chen, Master Lin Dong, and King Xiao Yan fought fiercely in order to protect millions of lives.

Meanwhile, the Beast Continent was also shrouded in the shadow of war. Ministers plotted and schemed after the Monkey King was assassinated. The Monkey Prince Lu Zhun had been in exile for three years. But now it was time for him to return to the capital Dongchuan. Will he be able to uncover the truth behind his father’s death, and will he be able to take his rightful place on the throne and become the next Emperor of the Beasts?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Battle Through The Heavens: Return Of The Beasts

Sosuke Aikawa lives in a run-down apartment. One night, the ceiling caves in, and the upstairs tenant falls on top of him...

112331.description: A certain school has an elegant girl known as Hime (princess), and another girl so handsome she's known as Ouji (prince). They live their school life always following these roles, but in reality these girls are nothing like their names, with one having a bad temper and one always crying. Can they fool their classmates?
112331.hashtag: #ツン姫さまとダメ王子ちゃん

title.native: ツン姫さまとダメ王子ちゃん

112332.description: This city is awfully big. Although we may not know each other, we may have brushed past each other on the road at some point. Perhaps we share a love of reading the same book and listening to the same song, or perhaps we’ll talk about love with an expiration date of one day. But on this day, we saw each other’s true selves, and that will forever be engraved on our lives.

112333.description:
Notes:

synonyms: Until the Day You Become God

112334.description:
Shibamaru is a clumsy little spirit who can’t quite master transformation magic. He lives happily in the mountains with his older brother, Kuromaru. Kuromaru always transforms into a human to gather food for them in town. Wanting to go along with him, Shibamaru finally manages to take on a human form one day and ventures into the human city, but...?!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: ヒーローのいない世界

112335.description:
Bitten by a vampire at a club, nineteen-year-old En barely survived. Taken under the wing of Ichii — a member of the health and welfare division of the vampire rights organization known as FANGS — En learns he's to be taught about this new "world" he must survive in.

In order to control the urge to suck blood and attack innocents, FANGS established a "pairing system", where two vampires support one another with regular meals. As a young, virginal vampire, En is highly sought after by many senior vamps. That is, until he declares his intention to pair with his guardian, Ichii...

112342.description:
Inuzuka Yuu is unable to make any friends due to his mean face and awkwardness. But because of his enrollment to high school, he has the opportunity to enter the dorms. However, it was a share house between 6 people, 3 girls and 3 boys filled with secrets!?

Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title.romaji: Koi Shita no de Haishin Shite Mita

112343.description:
At the age of 20, she graduated from a top school in the United States with double major. At 23, she bought a new villa for her parents. She, Wei Yujin, had risen from the mud to the peak of fame in the 21st century, and she's going to do the same in ancient China.

(Source: WeComics)
synonyms: 廃妃に転生した私は小説を書く

112344.description: Hero, Takamasa and wizard, Phil, who defeated the demon king and saved the world and the princess. Phil continued to travel with Takamasa who had an unrequited love for the princess, but Phil had erased his memory every time he captured and embraced Takamasa, who still thinks of the princess!

112345.description:
"Working part-time in the family restaurant doesn't take much! I just need to take orders and bring the food, right?" said Chiharu, a 29-years-old housewife, casually before even started yet. But, everything is not going as what she thought!

(Source: Manga.Club)

112346.description:
Reborn as the daughter of a humble family in the countryside, Evie Collins has settled into a quiet and uneventful life in the boonies. Everything changes when she becomes the sole commoner up against 100 noble ladies to marry Crown Prince Ikasha, one of the most powerful rulers in the world. But rumors say his face is horribly disfigured, always hidden behind a mask. Is that why his marriage is up to this most unusual contest? Can Evie hold her own against the field of haughty aristocrats and unravel the mysteries of the man behind the mask? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: TappyToon)

112347.description:
I was the last swan to take human form. Once I peeped out of the lake and a ring was thrown in front of me. For this ring, I met a shemale! After I figured out who the shemale really was, he taught me, and somehow became my 100th girlfriend!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Flying Over a Thousand Mountains to Love You
Volando Sobre Mil Montañas Para Amarte

title.romaji: Feiyue Qian Shan Lai Ai Ni

112348.description:
All her life, Elizabeth has been eclipsed by her warmhearted younger sister, who cares for the common people and rejects the privileges of nobility. In contrast, Elizabeth is seen as an out-of-touch aristocrat who loves to throw lavish parties and frequent the royal palace. Although she works hard for the good of the kingdom, her contributions go largely unnoticed because of her unsavory reputation. One of the few people who are willing to give her a chance is the Archduke of Winternight, the “monster of the North.” As a misunderstood soul himself, he feels a special connection to her and opens up his home. And so, Elizabeth moves to the far North, away from the people she’s known her whole life... Will she finally be able to start over with a clean slate? Or will her past stand in the way of her future with the Archduke?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Chapter Count:
Season 1: Prologue + 99 chapters
Intermission: 10 chapters
Season 2: 82 chapters

Note: Based on a Korean novel by the Korean author Nunoiz, the webcomic is drawn by a Chinese artist and was first released in Chinese.

112349.description: Shino is in her thirties and under pressure from her family and environment to finally marry. Out of the blue, Mayuki, a couple of years younger, confesses his love for her. But can she really get involved in such an impulsive crush or is it time to settle down?

112350.description: Oneshot from Ishu Renai Monogatarishuu anthology.

112351.description: This is a love story about two people who chose to give up their lives and live as different people.
synonyms: A Story about Armored King and Captive Princess

title.native: 鎧の王様と囚われの姫君の話
title.romaji: Yoroi no Ousama to Toraware no Himegimi no Hanashi

112352.description:
Hikari (Ω) works in the night business and only cares about money. One day, salaryman Seiroudou Dan (α) asks Hikari to give a farewell gift to his boss, who was Hikari's regular client and is now transferring to a different unit.

Since his best client and money source is leaving, Hikari wanted to catch Seiroudou but they unexpectedly cause each other's heat and end up becoming mates during intercourse. It's not much of a deal for Hikari... but the serious Seiroudou wants to get married!

112354.description:
The story of Kim Taeyang, a doctor in a mental hospital, and Kang Hyun, his patient, and the silent wounds they carry between them.

(Source: Toomics)

112355.description:

6. Shiofuki Kanrinin Masato-kun (しおふき管理人真人くん); Comic ExE Vol. 11

112358.description: Ling Fei Will fight though two worlds will he be able to unravel to secret of both? After an accident he woke up in a mystical cultivation realm. But when earth called him back he had the chance to relive his life on earth. What will he do with this second chance?

title.romaji: Du Shi Chao Ji Shen Zun

112359.description:
You've been holding in your carnal desires for so long, your body has become pitiful...

The next target of Seiji Kiriya, a private investigator, is Hiroki Yano, the go-getting secretary of a powerful politician who has "special information." To get the information he needs, Seiji succeeds in becoming Hiroki's "friend in bed."

As they consummate their passion-filled physical relationship over and over again, Seiji realizes that Hiroki has feelings for a special someone and starts to get jealous. In comparison, Hiroki has a secret he can't tell Seiji, becoming overwhelmed with feelings for his new friend...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Carnal Desire Paradox -The Guard Dog Gets Feisty At Night-
title.native: 劣情PARADOX―番犬は夜、牙をむく
title.romaji: Retsujou PARADOX: Banken wa Yoru, Kiba wo Muku

112360.description:
Tong Xi met her childhood playmate Nan Yi when she was back in town, but what had happened in childhood has made them strangers. All the smiles, pains, secrets and the delicate love that we’ve experienced during adolescence are also happening right in this beautiful small town...

(Source: WebComics, edited)

112361.description:
My sister went missing. Her social media account is still active, but I don't think it's her on the other side…

(Source: Toomics)

112362.description: A down-on-her-luck witch comes home for tea.

112363.description: An elderly lady is spending her last few hours cleaning and reminiscing in her old house before it's time to move out. But it seems that a tiny unexpected visitor is ready to get in the way!
synonyms: The House With Chinese Trumpet Vines

112365.description: The story of the Devil who picked up an Angel's child.
synonyms: The Day You Came Falling Down

112366.description:
When homicide detective Dexter J. Daley’s testimony helps send his partner away for murder, the consequences—and the media frenzy—aren’t far behind. He soon finds himself sans boyfriend, sans friends, and, after an unpleasant encounter in a parking garage after the trial, he’s lucky he doesn’t find himself sans teeth. Dex fears he’ll get transferred from the Human Police Force’s Sixth Precinct, or worse, get dismissed. Instead, his adoptive father—a sergeant at the Therian-Human Intelligence Recon Defense Squadron, otherwise known as the THIRDS—pulls a few strings, and Dex gets recruited as a Defense Agent.

Dex is determined to get his life back on track and eager to get started in his new job. But his first meeting with Team Leader Sloane Brodie, who also happens to be his new jaguar Therian partner, turns disastrous. When the team is called to investigate the murders of three Humanitherian activists, it soon becomes clear to Dex that getting his partner and the rest of the tightknit team to accept him will be a lot harder than catching the killer—and every bit as dangerous.

(Source: Dreamspinner Press)

112367.description:
Qatora was once a valiant knight of the Razanate Empire who gave her life to protect a young imperial noble. The tragedy cast her into the primordial Light of Origin, which not only revealed to her a dangerous secret... but also reincarnated her! She now lives as Lyse Winslette, the humble daughter of a poor baron in a neighboring country, who is doing everything in her power to keep her distance from the empire because of the forbidden knowledge she possesses. Lyse thus works her days away at the royal palace of Olwen as a lady-in-waiting. And she’s rightfully mortified when she’s chosen to attend the visiting Razanate emperor. Little does she know that she’s about to learn another state secret that’s going to land her... an engagement to an imperial knight?! She’ll have to use all her skills—from this life and her last—to get out of this mess. Yet what is this strange feeling when she touches her fiancé’s hand? Just who is Sidis, and what secrets is HE keeping?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

The Court Lady of the Emperor Is Hoped for as His Bride
The Emperor Hopes for the Court Lady as His Bride

title.native: 皇帝つき女官は花嫁として望まれ中
title.romaji: Koutei-tsuki Nyokan wa Hanayome to shite Nozomare-chuu

112372.description:
One day in the near future, the Japanese Self-Defense Force decides to transfer the command (and financing) of their air force to private companies and investors. Most reject the idea as a joke, but some show business-oriented companies catch up on the idea, spawning the birth of a new type of idol: the so-called "Idol Pilots", celebrity combat pilots.

The five Toreishi sisters, Kanna, Yayoi, Satsuki, Uzuki, and Mina, are teenage idol singers who are collectively known as The Hummingbirds. They are also one of the ace fighter pilot squadrons in the Japanese military. When they aren't saving the world from major overseas threats, they are on stage in frilly dresses, pursuing their idol career. This is the story of how they came to be Japan's most successful idol group and their first line of defense.

title.native: アイドル防衛隊ハミングバード

112373.description: During a field trip with their middle school classmates, childhood friends Kaguya and Himawari are abducted by the secret society Millennium. The evil organization is notorious for the havoc it's wreaked, but is it possible they're...not the bad guys? After Kaguya gets a glimpse behind the curtain, everything starts to change, and she becomes privy to the truth underneath the world she lives in. Now that she's bestowed with the power to transform into a magical girl, what path will she choose?
synonyms: 魔法少女 フレイミング☆スター

title.english: Divine Raiment Magical Girl Howling Moon
title.native: 神装魔法少女ハウリングムーン

112377.description:
Kang Haru, also known as Kay-D from the popular idol group 'Miracle Knights', is running away from his life of fame... but what will he find on this charming little island?

(Source: Toomics)

112378.description:
"I'm into someone." Cang Shu, a straight-A student who always indulges in learning and has no passion for social contact, actually announces in public that she likes the poor student Qi Lin?! Thanks to a misunderstanding, the two of them begin to get to know each other. When a girl who disdains to make friends meets another girl who desires to be loved, what will occur between them?

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: She Is Cute Today As Well

title.native: 今天的她也是如此可爱
title.romaji: Jintian De Ta Yeshi Ruci Keai

112379.description: Mirei, an 18 years old studying as a specialized student in design, was proposed to by Mano during her high school graduation. Now preparing for her wedding in the summer with a handsome high-class man, this marriage seems like a dream. In reality, these two haven’t even taken their relationship into adulthood yet! How will the naive Mirei handle their newlywed life?

title.romaji: Boku no Ie ni Oide: Wedding

112380.description: As a spotlessly upstanding man, Kusakabe has no use for relationships with the opposite sex. He keeps women at a distance, insisting that love and lust would only lead a man to ruin. However, one day, a cute neighbor, Hiiragi-san, moves in next door and asks him for his used tissues!? And so begins the story of an ascetic guy and a friendly neighbor succubus, a heart-thumping one-shot comedy!!

title.native: マジメサキュバス柊さん

112382.description:
Aikawa doesn't expect to make many friends in high school due to his large size, attitude and the scar on his face. He doesn't avoid making friends with people, but he doesn't go seeking them out either. A boy in his class, Kisaki Taichi, seems to initially want to be his friend, but then he steps completely over that boundary when he confesses his love.

Aikawa is shocked, and tries to avoid the issue of homosexuality by using his continuing attachment to his first love, a girl named Suzuka, as a rejection technique. This backfires when Kisaki claims that he actually is Suzuka. He claims that he had been cross-dressing back then, and now his family name has changed due to his parents' divorce and remarriage. Will Aikawa still love this new Suzuka?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: 新・弐十手物語 つるじろう

Sagami's little sister suddenly couldn't make it to her omiai meeting...! Headed to the meeting place to apologize on her behalf, Sagami met the last person he expected to see. It was Uehara, his senpai from college, the guy he used to sleep with. Each word he spoke brought back memories from that time... A story of an ended love and sensitive romance suddenly revived.

112392.description:
A death game where players are forced to kill one another until there's only one person left standing!

This is the story of Ryosuke Miyauchi, a young man who survived a real-life battle royale game three years ago, and who has been struggling to live a normal life since then. One day, Ryosuke was scouted by the enormously popular game developer EDC, who asked him, "Why don't you use your special experience to make a game?"

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

112393.description:
Aya was deserted right before her marriage and was left without a place to live. One day, she finds herself wandering back into the house she was supposed to own after her wedding. To her surprise, the cold-blooded boss she hates from work had moved in as the new owner! A dangerous love ignites under one roof between the girl who lost love and her sadistic boss!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

112394.description:
The platelets may be the littlest members of the Cells at Work team, but they won’t let that stop them! They’ve got the important job of closing wounds, which they do with pride…and a few hijinks along the way!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

112395.description:
Gia meets Hayden on a train to Prague, the fateful stop that marks the start of their 100 days journey of a fairytale romance in Europe.

(Source: Tapas)

112396.description:
Ryuukyuu (ancient Okinawa) is in its golden era in 1482. A young girl named Yuuna is shunned by her community because she has the ability to talk to animals. Her only friends are a pair of lions named Shii and Saa. One day the rumor of Yuuna’s god-given gifts reaches the King’s ears. Shou Shin travels to meet Yuuna in disguise, kicking off their strange adventure...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

synonyms: not only good but also bad

title.native: たいへん不良くできました

112399.description:
Andou Kanna is obsessed with a dating sim mobile game called Special Master-sama Complete. In order to earn money to buy the in-game gacha tickets, she looks for a high-paying part-time job. However... when she answers an ad for a job that pays in gacha tickets, she meets a group of young men who all look just like the characters in the game...?! What's more, the real versions don't act anything like their gallant game counterparts, and are always picking on her! Love in games and in real life... surely it can't be that simple...?

(Source: Kadokawa Gempak Starz)

synonyms: I Can Only Say I Love You

112401.description:
Shuku Sakae is a high school freshman who has never experienced love, but is interested in it. She falls in love with Aoto Musubu, a kind and shy classmate who had to repeat a grade due to a certain accident last year. But she is quickly heartbroken after finding out that Aoto already has a girl that he likes. Shuku then decides to put her love aside and chooses to support Aoto's love.

Included one-shots: Dokidoki Gokko (ドキドキごっこ), Sakurako no Isu (桜子のイス)

title.native: 好きにならずにいられない

112402.description:
Daiki Tomita likes movies, but the real reason he’s still kept up with his university’s film club members after they all graduated is his unrequited love for fellow member Koharu Kobayakawa. He’s been hesitant to risk their friendship by asking her out, but when Koharu breaks the news that she doesn’t have long to live, Tomita must decide whether or not he’s willing to let her go without ever telling her how he truly feels…

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: A happy ending isn't necessary for our love

title.english: Our Love Doesn’t Need a Happy Ending
