112404.description:
The stage is post-revolutionary Paris, where the turmoil has yet to settle. In the city's outskirts, there is a cafe-patisserie called "Avenir," filled with unique personalities. In particular, Lucas, the younger brother of the shop manager Georges, is full of energy and a true lover of sweets. Utilizing his physical strength, he works as a delivery person, weaving through the streets of Paris every day. Meeting all sorts of people along the way, he occasionally gets into trouble. However, with his friendly nature, caring attitude, and the sweet aroma of his pastries, he gently leads people's hearts to a happy ending. Each chapter features a different pastry, as well as exclusive bonus drawings, behind-the-scenes anecdotes, and must-see recipes, exclusively in the collected volume!

(Source: Jitsugyo no Nihonsha, translated)

112406.description:
A collection of short stories that explore the shadowy territories of love.

A bond of love is a beautiful thing, but what happens when outside pressures force it into forms both strange and strained.

1. Torokeru Koibito (とろける恋人, Melting Lover)
A lovesick youth encounters a mysterious shapeshifter with the ability to take on the appearance of his beloved.

2. Tengoku no Soko (天国の底, Bottom of Heaven)
A hitman forswears pleasure, but cannot shake the fun-loving angel determined to follow him on his assignments.

3-4. Circus mo Yahan-sugi ni wa (サーカスも夜半過ぎには, The Circus After Midnight)
Two circus performers keep explosive secrets from one another while sharing the trapeze.

5. noisy jungle
An android finds himself malfunctioning under the gaze of his pet human.

(Source: KUMA, edited)

112407.description:
Su Xueshen, the 34th Queen of Nine Tails Fox tried to break through her demon body and ascend to immortality. However, Zongbo the Qiongqi, the demon that was refused by her many times, sabotaged her plan at the last tribulation. To recover her cultivation by using the prince's Loong Qi, Su Xueshen agreed to be his temporary princess consort. A story between a resourceful "weak" prince and a distrait princess consort.

(Source: Webnovel)

112408.description: Eque is a popular, beautiful cross-dressing woman and Tania is a playful queen. This is their unique and interesting royal comedy. Tales of ambition, dark plans, the secrets of royalty and ghosts. Plus love and misunderstanding and the pride of a woman are involved?!

112410.description:
Based on the writings of Julius Caesar, who described his first-hand account of the Gallic Wars in Commentarii de Bello Gallico.

(Source: Anime-Planet)

112411.description: Growing up, Takara Rio has always wanted siblings. So when her parents decide to move overseas without her and tells her she will be living with two people around her age, she's cautiously optimistic. But they turn out to be brothers who fight like cats and dogs. Is this what having siblings is like?

112412.description:
Dong Chu, the princess of a small southern country, travels thousands of miles alone to a foreign land with a single goal in mind: breaking off her engagement with her fiancé, the Great Lord of the Northern Territory! His name is Lin Zhenying, and he’s horrendously cruel and arrogant. After she arrives, however, her fiancé is overthrown and cursed to remain in the form of a small child. Taking pity on his now considerably weaker state, Dong Chu pledges to help him reclaim his throne and to gain power once more.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Chapter count includes two season prologues and three extras chapters.
synonyms: 結婚、やめませんか？～花姫と○○になった王～

112413.description:
The youngest daughter who worries about completely pointless things. The super indecissive middle daughter. The extremely annoying, lip smacking eldest daughter. Starting with these three sisters, this is a story about loveable, clumsy people. A short slice of life comedy that surprisingly has nothing to do with the universe!!

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: These are tiny problems if you compare them to the universe

title.native: 宇宙とかと比べたらちっぽけな問題ですが
title.romaji: Uchuu Toka to Kurabetara Chippoke na Mondai desu ga

112414.description: A collection of author's early works.

112415.description: Lee Yonik, a student who decided to become independent, suffers from being able to keep up; but everything will change when he finds a rice cooker in the park. A strange man came out of a rice cooker that I picked up! WHAT THE HELL IS GOING ON?!

112417.description: Freshman Yoonchan created quite a spectacle during the welcome party for first years. Ah-in, who just got back to school after taking some time off, somehow got himself involved with this guy who's got absolutely no sense. Things happened and now, they're actually dating?! This kind of relationship that doesn't make any sense at all... will it be okay?

title.native: 世紀末倫敦ミステリー事件簿　背徳の学び舎
title.romaji: Seikimatsu London Mystery Jikenbo: Haitoku no Manabiya

112420.description:
“She’s a blooming rose, mesmerizing with her beauty, drawing people in, only to leave them drenched in blood.”

College couple Kirita and Ariko share a life that feels almost like marriage. One day, their new neighbor moves in: Kanon, the stunning woman Kirita once secretly loved back in high school. Their peaceful days as a couple slowly begin to twist out of balance.

A swirling love triangle between the boyfriend, the girlfriend, and the wicked woman! Elegant yet delicate. Alluring yet dangerous. In every age, it is the wicked woman who makes the world spin. Beside their quiet, ordinary life lies the extraordinary, a neighbor and suspense love story.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)
synonyms: เสน่หาอาฆาต

112421.description:
Haibara Tatsuyuki, an employee of a financial company, has just gotten out of prison. Life on the outside is not proving to be as happy as he imagined. His long-time girlfriend, Akemi, has left him, and he got laid off from his job. Strangely enough, he lost his job due to 'restructuring,' and not due to his recently acquired criminal record. His colleague, Kuwata, has also lost his job, and he has decided to form his own financial company, which specializes in recovering bad debts. Since his convict status leaves Haibara very few options, he joins Kuwata's new company, and his new life-after-prison begins...

(Source: MangaHelpers)

112422.description: Yuuichi is a plain, gloomy guy, but after getting hit by a car, he wakes up in a parallel world where the Omegaverse is real. Not only is he an alpha, but Miki, who hated him with a vengeance in the normal world, is now his omega!

112423.description:
1-2) Isekai ni Tondara Rival ni Hameraretemashita!? (異世界に飛んだらライバルにハメられてました!?)
Amatatsu is a brash, but normal high school student until he wakes up in the middle of doing it with another guy!! To make matters worse, the culprit is his biggest rival, Sen! Is it really possible he's come to a parallel world where he and Sen are a couple...!?

3) Voice Complex (ボイスコンプレックス)
4) Shinyuu no Tachiichi (親友の立ち位置)
5) Momasete Marshmallow Honey (揉ませてマシュマロハニー)
6) Isekai no Ore ga Rival deshita!? (異世界の俺がライバルでした!?)

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Isekai no Ore ga Rival deshita!?

title.english: I'm Banging My Rival in a Parallel World!?
title.native: 異世界に飛んだらライバルにハメられてました!?
title.romaji: Isekai ni Tondara Rival ni Hameraretemashita!?

112424.description: The manga follows the adventures of a Pokémon Trainer, Akira, and his Charizard.
synonyms: Pokémon: The Legend of the Dragon King

title.native: ポケットモンスターX・Y ポケモン竜王伝

112425.description:
Based on the hugely popular musical of the same name, Elisabeth details the life of the Austrian Empress in the 19th century. At a very young age, she marries the Emperor Franz Joseph and is whisked away to the opulence of the Viennese court. The stagnant court functions stifle her while she struggles with her own quest for personal freedom. She is tormented by her own psychological decay and a fading Austrian monarchy. And throughout her life she is strongly drawn to a mysterious figure...Death.

(Source: xkazemg)

title.native: 3泊4日ホワイトホース オーロラツアーの旅

112427.description:
Miku Hoshino is a just a regular girl who thinks of nothing but her favorite idol, Rei, from the totally popular group M.A.G. When her school duties make her miss the concert she was desperately hoping to go for, she does what any girl would do—takes the help of a witch! But when the witch turns Miku into a witch, too, her life becomes anything from ordinary...and a certain keen-eyed detective seems determined to keep it that way!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

112428.description:
1. Sawaranu Loli ni Tatari Nashi! (さわらぬ神〈◯リ〉にたたりなし！); Comic ExE #01
2-4. Dasshutsu! Chibikko Senyou Sharyou (脱出！ちびっ娘専用車両); Comic X-Eros #06, #08, #11
5. Locker no Kami-sama. (ロッカーの神さま。, Locker God); Comic X-Eros #18
6. Idainaru Idol (偉大なる詐欺団〈アイドル〉); Comic X-Eros #25
7. Hina-chan to Aruku ATM (ひなちゃんと歩くATM, Hina-chan & The Walking ATM); Comic X-Eros #31

title.native: だから神様、ボクにしか見えないちいさな恋人をください。
title.romaji: Dakara Kamisama, Boku ni shika Mienai Chiisana Koibito wo Kudasai.

112429.description:
We may be the only ones left in the world. In a world that was laid to a ruin with no one left, a young man, Ray, searches for people other than himself and Richie while she watches over him with worry. During this, a "secret" that had stayed hidden for 15 years is revealed by an invader from the skies. The young man, who is now alone, starts walking because of "a certain word." The curtain on a fantasy tale of people and machines in the near future rises here.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: A kiss on your singing voice

title.romaji: Kimi no Utagoe ni Kiss wo

112431.description: The story revolves around Kokoro Mimori, a woman who works in an office and has just discovered that she is suspected of being in an extramarital affair. The person who offers a helping hand to Kokoro is the kind and handsome lawyer Jin Uemiya. However, he has a dark side! However, Kokoro only has him to turn to...

112432.description:
OL who likes bishounen discovers that her guardian angel is a little boy who has been living with her all along. Though he can't protect her completely because he's still a child, he tries his best. Also a demon bishounen moves in next door so that he can take her soul.

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.native: 天使が家にやってきた

112433.description: The story is about the romance between a poor woman and an older man.

title.native: 本日、キスの予定はございません。
title.romaji: Honjitsu, Kiss no Yotei wa Gozaimasen.

112435.description:
The manga is set one year after Kazuhiko and Mizuho High School's inter-high victory, and is set in the famous Shōnan Dai Sagami High School, Mizuho's rival school. The manga centers on Fuse, the school basketball team's ace who aims for the nationals, and a new freshman protagonist.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: アラサーだけど初恋します。

112439.description:
Urasawa's characters confront fantastical elements ranging from psychic powers, to alien visitors to planet Earth, to attacks by giant monsters. On the flip side, the author philosophizes about his real-world experiences with the wild and wacky international music scene.

Plus, a classic, funny animal tale, in Urasawa's inimitable style!

(Source: VIZ Media)

1. DAMIYAN!
2. Tsuki ni mukatte nagero!
3. Oyaji Shu
4. Henry and Charles
5. It's a Beautiful Day
6. Musica Nostra
7. Kaiju Okoku
8. Solo Mission

title.native: くしゃみ 浦沢直樹短編集

112440.description:
Young and rambunctious Belle insists on going out to play in the forbidden woods, but her adventurous streak abruptly ends when her mother is spirited away by a beast known to kidnap beautiful women. Twisted by the loss of his wife, Belle’s father keeps his daughter, who has unusual, violet hair, locked away in an effort to “protect” her from prying eyes. Finally emerging after years of solitude, Belle ventures back into the woods where she lost her mother and encounters the beast once more…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: chapter count includes 20 bonus chapters.
synonyms: Belle & das Biest im verlorenen Paradies
La Belle et la Bête du Paradis Perdu

title.english: Beauty and the Beast of Paradise Lost

112442.description: An accompaniment to the Umineko visual novel, featuring several side stories and a prologue for Hotarubi no Tomoru Koro ni. Several of these side stories are included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa and Hane.
synonyms: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: The First and the Last Gift

title.native: うみねこのなく頃に～最後で最初の贈り物～
title.romaji: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Saigo de Saisho no Okurimono

112445.description:
The asexual Ikki is going out with Karakita, his senior from work. But while Ikki is happy to just spend time with Karakida, whom he loves dearly, he also feels anguish at not being able to fully satisfy his partner's desires...? A boys' love story depicting the highs and lows, and the varying seasons of men's life.

(Source: Hero's, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, the manga was then compiled by Libre for commercial release on October 19, 2019. A Director's Cut edition was published by Hero's on January 29, 2024.

112446.description: A collection of 9 pure love stories between beast boyfriends and human heroines! The senior I'm curious about is a beastman...? The love between a beastman and his "sister" is forbidden...? A designer girl falls in love with a young beastman who looks like a dog? A thrilling romance anthology where you can enjoy a variety of situations with beastmen in various settings!

title.native: 獣人カレシに愛されアンソロジー

112456.description:
Long before even the distant past, the land was ruled by powerful kami, gods as widely varied in form and temper as the parishes they governed, each possessing a unique sacred instrument. Traveling between their shrines in search of divine favor, the priest En the Layman and his two assistants brave dangerous terrain, fearsome creatures, and the wrath of kami themselves!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Touge Oni: Primal Gods in Ancient Times

112457.description:
They call him a demon, yet his sword dominates the heavens and his power shakes the universe, transcending even the immortals! They brand him a Buddha, yet he slaughters wherever he goes, mountains of corpses piled up and rivers of blood streaming, more demonic than demon itself! Cleansing his body with blood and tempering his bones with fire, in the cycle of life and death, he becomes a great demonic lord! The young Lin Feng rises above his hardships, unexpectedly acquiring the Demonic Seed, thus becoming the only Demonic Patriarch in this universe!

(Source: MangaToon)

112458.description:
Shiraishi is a middle school teacher who is fed up with everything. She was dumped by her longtime girlfriend, and she hates her job. Every day she deals with bratty students and their irrational parents, and today was no different. She was making her usual rounds to her students' homes to speak with their parents, as she approached the last house. Here we go, another crazy parent...she thought to herself. But the woman who came to the door was...beautiful, calm, and extremely her type.

(Source: eManga)

Note: Originally released as a One Shot online.

112460.description:
It's no easy feat to keep a body happy and healthy, so even the newest cells have their tiny-winey, chubby-wubby hands full! Join these cute baby cells as they work hard within their newborn baby body, in this newest (literally!) spinoff of Cells at Work!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

112461.description:
Competent and pretty, Yui is a girl who even her coworkers are envious of. She's got a great job, but possibly because she's a bit overconfident, her relationships don't last, and she doesn't have much of a personal life. The one person who's always been by her side is her childhood friend, Akira. He's kind of a pushover when it comes to Yui. She'd always thought of him as a sweet kid, like a younger brother... but when she trips and lands on him and accidentally kisses him, it triggers something in him that turns him into a hungry beast! He wants her body and teases her while whispering into her ear how wet she's getting. He's not the Akira she knows at all...!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Beast x Switch- My Girlfriend is the On-Off Switch to My Beast Mode

title.english: Awakening The Beast Inside Him-My Childhood Friend Turns Into A Beast In Bed!-
title.native: ケダモノ×スイッチ  〜純情幼なじみと野獣なエッチ？
title.romaji: Kedamono x Switch: Junjou Osanajimi to Yajuu na Ecchi?

112462.description:
Megumi has been avoiding guys most of her life for a particular reason. She goes to work at a supply shop that only hires female staff and has been avoiding trouble by working in the back.

But, the owner suddenly drops by, and even though he's good-looking, his attitude sucks. Also, he's a grown guy who seems like a total playboy! She in no way wants to work with him! The reason for this is because when Megumi's with a guy, "exciting" accidents keep happening...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: No Matter What I Do, I End up Having Private Time with the Owner
title.native: どう転んでもオーナーとR18展開になってしまいます。
title.romaji: Dou Koronde mo Owner to R18 Tenkai no Natte shimaimasu.

112463.description: A mysterious monster has appeared at school and has declared he will eat "one person a day"! Deciding the value of lifes is the key for survival! What will be the fate of the protagonist once he becomes the designated food!?
synonyms: It's Time to Go to His Stomach, Ok?

title.native: 明日のエサ キミだから

synonyms: Slow Life ga Shitai Daikensha, Musume o Hirou.
The Great Sage Who Wants "Slow Life" Raises a Daughter.

title.native: スローライフがしたい大賢者、娘を拾う。
title.romaji: Slow Life ga Shitai Daikensha, Musume wo Hirou.

112465.description:
Super pretty boy twins that will love the heroine!!

When Tsumugi entered high school she became a sponger in Kise’s household, living with twin brothers 1 year older than her!!

A story that will certainly make you smile if you read it, the strongest love comedy starts now!

Note: Includes three extras chapters.

112466.description: A sequel to Hachimitsu to Clover, focusing on Ayu and Nomiya.

title.native: ハチミツとクローバー 君は僕のたからもの
title.romaji: Hachimitsu to Clover: Kimi wa Boku no Takaramono

112467.description: Sequel to Hachimitsu to Clover, focusing on Ayu and Nomiya.

title.native: ハチミツとクローバー やさしい風

112469.description:
In appearance, Sakurako is a model student. But behind this pure image she gives relies a different truth: she in an inveterate yaoi fan. A terrible secret which, if it get to be revealed, will tarnish her reputation and her mother's, who is a novelist.

When two boys from Sakurako's school dicover who she really is, things aren't going to be as easy for her anymore...

112473.description: Segawa is assigned to clean the aviary with the evil looking Ninomiya.

112474.description: A part time reporter goes back to his old home to do a special report on part time spirits, only to bring up dark secrets from his past...

112475.description:
Those who make contracts with devils gain the power to curse others to death. Their mortal enemy: the Curse Detective Kiyoharu Saeyama, who uses traces of the curses left on their victims to uncover the identities of these sick killers. Let this deadly, paranormal game of psychological warfare begin!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: นักสืบเหนือมนุษย์ ไขคำสาปมรณะ

title.native: 誰かを呪わずにいられないこの世界で
title.romaji: Dareka wo Norawazu ni Irarenai Kono Sekai de

112476.description:
A reborn and revenge story. This time, let me protect you!

Nan Yun, daughter of a merchant, fell in love with the rebellious General Huo Mingcheng and became his Empress Consort. However, Huo Mingcheng sentenced her to death to please his new lover. The snow in June allowed Nan Yun a second chance in living her life again. She was reborn to revenge, and she’s determined to reverse her tragedy…Under her cold appearance, she was gradually touched by Yan Zechen, and the sincere affection silently grew between them when he’s protecting her in silence. It turned out that they had met each other in the previous life…

(Source: Wecomics)
synonyms: The Bloody Merchant Empress and the Cold Husband's Forceful Doting

title.romaji: Yu Xue Shang Hou: Leng Fu Qiang Chong

112477.description:
Shoji is a high-school student who isn't very good at asserting herself. At his side is Narukami, the most feared boy in school. He looks frightening and all she hears are stories about his delinquent behavior. However, Narugami-kun is completely mistaken and thinks Koji likes him...?　
</br>
</br>
(Source: cmoa, translated)

title.native: そのキス間違ってます

112481.description: “Maou Army’s strongest magician” I’m called. Ike, a demon capable of capturing a fort alone. Clearing away enemies with immense magic, he is without a doubt a monster awed by friend and foe. However he has a secret he can’t tell other demons. “I, actually I’m human you know.” Using modern knowledge to keep his secret, he became treated as a great commander and the driving force of the Maou’s army.
synonyms: Maou-gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta
The Maou Army's Strongest Magician Was a Human

title.native: 魔王軍最強の魔術師は人間だった
title.romaji: Maou Gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta

112482.description:
The one who protects the princess is the beasts that can transform into humans!?
Yoseph the bear, Ludwig the hound, Miers the Canaria and Lichart the white horse, are the only friends Yulia, Vek Kingdom's first princess, has. Inside the tower which she can't escape from, Yulia spends her days leisurely with her friends reading books and listens to stories. One night, accused of assassinated the king and queen, Yulia escaped into the forest with her friends, her favorite book and a little bag she got from her mother.

"When you’re in serious trouble...this will save you..." Remembering her mother's words, Yulia opens the bag. Inside the bag is rainbow powder...?! Fantasy romance of Love and adventure of the Princess and the beasts who are chased by the Kingdom. Popular Otome Game "Beast and Princess" long-awaited comicalize! (Source: Endless Journey)

112483.description:
To find her missing father, Tachibana Izumi goes to search for him at the Mankai Company Theatre he once worked at as the director. What she finds there, however, is the theatre group burdened with a huge sum of debt, just one young actor, and no success worthy of mention. To save the theatre group her father had loved so dearly, Izumi has to become the new director and re-establish the four troupes: Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter; and lead the theatre group to success.

This manga follows the story of the second troupe, the Summer Troupe (Natsu-gumi).

112484.description:
Shizuma and Minato are officially a couple. But Shizuma—now a resident veterinarian—is so busy he barely has time to catch his breath, let alone go on a date. When he finally manages to find time for Minato, the universe intervenes once again, and he learns quickly that his feisty new beau is not to be ignored!

(Source: SuBLime)

title.native: セラピーゲーム リスタート

112485.description:
Impatient 29-year old omega Shishikura has watched all his friends get married while his own romances keep fizzling out. Determined to find someone compatible, he turns to a matchmaking service. But while waiting for his perfect soulmate to be found, he goes into heat at the worst possible moment—alone with Kotani, a new coworker who is nursing a longtime grudge against Shishikura! After spending a desperate steamy night together, there’s no doubt that the two are physically compatible, but do they even like each other?

(Source: SuBLime)
synonyms: I Can't Believe You're My Fated Partner!

title.native: 運命の番がお前だなんて
title.romaji: Unmei no Tsugai ga Omae da Nante

112487.description: A secret love exchanged from hand to hand.

112488.description: A foolish and stubborn little servant girl has to serve this Lord day and night. This lord is not only crafty, unruly, and handsome, but the most most important thing is that he’s super lazy! He plays with his little servant girl all day long, but he cannot resist. What will they do?
synonyms: My Lord, Pay Attention to Your Reputation!

112489.description: A continuation of the manga "Shiritsu Kiwamemichi Koko", this story follows Tora of his quest to become the most notorious gangster in all of Japan. When he encounters Gakubo Masa, the boss of the Gokumasa family, he immediately admires him and joins the family on their rampages. Full on both laughter and violence, the manga takes reader everywhere from a juvenile reformatory all the way to the halls of the Diet. (Weekly Shonen Jump Exhibition Vol.1 Catalog)

112490.description:
The high school student Sena can just survive with several jobs. When, as usual, she pursues her work as a cleaner, the young entrepreneurial genius Kei Ogasawara suddenly appears in front of her. Suddenly, he makes her a marriage proposal from the middle of nowhere! And though he faces her coldly, meanly, and ruthlessly, emotions in Sena quickly sprout up for him. But why did he just make her an application?

Includes 5 side stories and a special "Konya, Sensei no Ude no Naka" chapter.

112491.description:
In the magical world of Alpi, divine spirits are the source of all life, communities living in harmony under their protection. However, when their lives end, a terrible curse drives them to evil, and these malign spirits must be sent to the afterlife by the Soul Senders. Alpi is one such girl, talented despite her young age, and assisted by her familiar Pelenai!

(Source: Titan Manga)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.
synonyms: Відправниця душ Альпі та поховальна подорож

title.native: 送魂の少女と葬礼の旅
title.romaji: Soukon no Shoujo to Sourei no Tabi

112493.description:
The plot follows the adventures of Red and his Pokémon as they travel to the Kalos region. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

title.native: ポケットモンスターX・Y編

112494.description: (In heat pregnancy x omegaverse) Kumo from the mountain dog tribe was picked up by Kin from the cat tribe and who lives near a wolf tribe doctor of the omegas, Ise. Whether it be Kumo having the characteristics of a dog, he tends to make playful nibbles and licks towards Kin. However, the fact that Ise was pleased with their excellent compatibility makes Kin’s heart ache…

112495.description:
Cristalia, the female leader of a small country, is adored by her people, is kidnapped by bandits on her way back from a mission to a large country. But then, she meets Randolph, the leader of the bandits...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: The Chivalrous Thief and the Captured Princess

title.native: クリスタリアの高貴な義賊

112496.description: Seven former fellow middle school students are forced to participate in a “death game” by an eerie ‘rabbit’. They have never met after graduating but now they must complete 6 death games within one hour to escape their entrapment! A game of despair begins as their dark past is revealed and their fragile relationships are put to the test!

112497.description:
The plot follows the adventures of Red and his Pokémon as they travel to the Alola region. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

title.native: ポケットモンスター サン・ムーン編

112498.description:
Takeuchi Kaoru is a young man with a special ability. He can experience the thoughts of others, just by copying their writings. Kaoru lives with his mother with Alzheimer's disease. He wants to become a writer, but, due to his special ability, he has a hard time writing his own work. Taking care of his sick mother also doesn't help his writing. One day, his mother gets into an accident.

Fujiwara Tomomi, who went to same school as Kaoru, appears in front of Kaoru. Tomomi is a young yakuza and he makes an offer to Kaoru. The deal is if Kaoru takes a university entrance exam for someone and that guy gets into a top university, then he will make a lot of money. But, Kaoru gets involved in something unexpected.

112499.description:
Chisato and Riku first met when she moved next door ten years ago. Even as college students, they're still neighbors after her mom suggests they get adjacent apartments since "it'll be safer." One day, Chisato casually mentions she wouldn't mind having a boyfriend. Riku's reaction of "Why not me!? I've had a crush on you forever!" totally catches her off guard. Can someone who's been the boy next-door for most of her life become something more...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: First Time with the Boy Next-Door
title.native: おとなりはじめてものがたり

112500.description: In a modern reimagining of the Ranpo Edogawa series, used bookstore owner Kogorou Akechi helps his childhood friend and detective Eiichirou Namikoshi solve crimes in Tokyo.

112502.description: A manga chronicling K-pop group SEVENTEEN's activities in Japan.

title.native: Say the name! SEVENTEEN～日本デビューまでの道～
title.romaji: Say The Name! SEVENTEEN: Nihon Debut made no Michi

title.native: 上からカテキョとナマイキ少年
title.romaji: Ue kara Katekyo to Namaiki Shounen

112505.description: In the era of Taisho, in Tokyo's Ginza district, there was a young girl who stood alone as a female hairdresser. Her name was Tsubame. From mischievous local boys to the heads of troubled noble families, she would show her skill in giving them a beautiful finish! This is the story of a 16-year-old prodigy female hairdresser, portrayed by the emerging talent, Mizuhoshi Matsumoto. Witness her journey of growth!

112506.description:
"Loving you isn't enough."

Ruka (omega) and Taisei (alpha) are mates. They don't live together and only meet when Ruka has his heat. When the sex is over, Taisei would hurry up and go home, and Ruka ends up unable to say the words "don't go!" Juliet no Baka is a painful love story about a couple unable to be honest with each other and their twisted relationship.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

112507.description: Follows middle schooler Kanade as she discovers the "hidden truths" about anti-Korean protests, comfort women, and other sensitive political topics.
synonyms: The Girls Trying to Bring About National Pride

112509.description: When Yuki Katakura woke up, it was in an unknown building. There were several men and women there, but no one knew why they were there. All doors are locked, and suspicious instruments are fitted around the neck. A girl appears in front of them who knew that they were confined in a closed room!

112510.description: Tadahiro Nasu is a downtrodden convenience store worker with nothing to live for but watching VR performances of Misaki Kanzaki, an idol who was once his classmate. Unable to take his oppressive life any longer, he electrocutes himself, only to find that his body has become pure electricity. With his newfound power to manipulate electrical objects, he'll do anything to support Misaki, whether she likes it or not.

synonyms: ディー・ディー・ジョーカー

112514.description:
Kujou Yuriko’s nickname is “The Perfect Girl” due to her stellarness, beauty, athletic ability, and academic acumen. She is the school idol everyone adores. But she has one fatal flaw: she is madly in love with Apollon, a fictional manga character. 112579.description:
Tomoyo Shiino has stood by her friend Mariko through years of abuse, abandonment, and depression. However horrific her circumstances, their friendship has been the one reassuring constant in Mariko's life-and Tomoyo's too. That is, until Tomoyo is utterly blindsided by news of Mariko's death. In life, Tomoyo felt powerless to help her best friend out of the darkness that ultimately drove her over the edge. Now, Tomoyo is determined to liberate Mariko's ashes for one final journey together... to set free her dear, broken Mariko.

(Source: Yen Press)

Yutaka is going back to live with his family after working at a different location for three years. What he was longing for all these years while living alone was to play with the kittens his wife found on a street. She sent him pictures of them every day, and they were all super cute. However, when he arrived at his home, the kittens don't come close to him. Why? They don't like me!?

(Source: BookWalker Global)

title.native: 飼い猫がなつきません

112584.description:
The Taishou-era romance manga follows Kaori Yoshino, a 16-year-old girl. Kaori marries the notorious 20-year-old Earl Tamaki Misono, president of her family's rival company. Although it is an arranged marriage, Kaori cannot resist Misono's love.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

112586.description:
The planet that Liza Luna, an investigator for the Space Empire, lands on is none other than Earth. Appalled by its low level of civilization, she initially plans to wipe it out without a second thought. However, she encounters an unknown phenomenon there known as cuteness. Will that cuteness turn out to be our unexpected savior?! This kicks off our new series packed with pure loveliness!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

112589.description:
Miyamoto Sakura is cute. Why, you ask?

1) She looks cute.
2) The way her expression is constantly changing is cute.
3) The way she gets so easily excited is cute.
4) Still remembering the proposal from when we were small is cute.
5) Her ti*s are surprisingly big.

…See, with all this together, how could she be anything but?

And so this novel exists to admire her, the purest novel in the world. Incidentally, my name is Oogami Hikaru, I’m Sakura’s childhood friend, and apparently the reincarnation of the Norse Deity Odin.
synonyms: Just a Story About Miyamoto Sakura Being Cute

title.romaji: Miyamoto Sakura ga Kawaii Dake no Shousetsu.

112591.description: Two years have passed, and Sakaki and Okada haven’t been getting along well as of late. Okada is determined to make things work, but the younger man remains dissatisfied. Where exactly did it all go wrong?

title.native: バイヤー皇帝二のお気に入り

112593.description: Est has long been under the protection of a guise of death. Aravis, a wizard and its lord protector, ventures out on a quest for answers and a higher power, against his sister Tule’s wishes. Far from fulfilling it, he is banished—and returns only to find Est in ruins, Tule little more than dead, and himself sapped of power.

112594.description: Li Qing, a small maintenance worker, was trying to live a honest life and doing a honest job. but he was inexplicably involved in a big family’s struggle. Whatsmore he had a terrifying secret of his own…

112596.description: Two part manga released in 1978-1979 in Weekly Shōnen Jump, notable for being Toriyama's first published manga. Wonder Island marks the debuts P-Man, who makes appearances in Dr. Slump, as well as Gyaosu, Gala and Pagos who later become recurring characters in Dr. Slump.

Yamaguchi is the smart, popular boy in school. After a recent classroom seat change, he's forced into the unfortunate situation of sitting next to Sato-san, a girl who - in Yamaguchi's mind - is as plain and boring as they come. But does he truly feel that way about Sato-san? Although her cluelessness is an issue, Sato-san has endearing qualities as well. As time goes on, will Yamaguchi's initial feelings of discomfort and annoyance subside into something different?

(Source: Mangamo)

This series is about 1000 years prior to the season 1 of Good luck, Demon King!

112610.description:
The heartbeat at the first moment we met, the trust when skin to skin, the story stars from these moments... The peaceful life of the doctor went to a unknown situation. But the embrace of this moment will be forever? The encounter was carefully designed by "the devil", but "the devil" cannot control his heart from now on... When the thin ice of love is broken, all good things changed into lies, where will they go...

He is a sunny, hilarious, positive and obscure actor. He is a composed, generous and graceful general manager. Because of a strange request, they began a long journey of attracting each other. What should they do? Nonsense, of course becoming lovers.

(Source: Webcomics)

112615.description:
They are not compatible, but somehow they became partners. A handsome and flustered guy asks, "What? Who says two good-looking guys can't appreciate each other? We are also going to develop feelings for each other..." "You want to solve cases with psychology?" "Someone who only knows how to solve things with their fists like an animal." A SWAT officer bites his ear lightly and says, "Do you want to know how animals do it?"

(Source: Webcomics)

112616.description: Hinata Mitsuura a baseball player, meeting his old friend from elementary school Yurika Nishizawa and they are going to an adventure.

112618.description:
Hinata Yamamoto, 15 years old, has a phobia of glasses due to a broken heart. She tries to make new friends at her new high school, but for some reason, all of her classmates have glasses!? Here and there, they're all wearing glasses! This is a comedic tale of youth where the main character isn't surrounded by enemies, but by glasses!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

112621.description:
In this juicy yuri manga, the goody-goody high school girl Sakurai meets a lonely girl—and ends up entangled in a web of blackmail that might just lead to romance. It's hard to keep up with school when you can never say no to a devious classmate!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

112627.description:
Izumi Yukihara, high school second year. His life is completely average-until a series of misfortunate events turn his life upside down. As if losing his parents weren't enough, he's saddled with their massive debt and forced to relocate to a new residence. On the bright side, the owners of his new residence offer him a chance to repay his debt...by serving cats?!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: 僕はお猫様の下僕です。
title.romaji: Boku wa Oneko-sama no Geboku desu.

112628.description:
The story is set one autumn at the beginning of the 21st century in the Uchihama area. Uchihama Academy is growing by leaps and bounds. With the construction of a new school building, there will be one last General Club Festival at the old building that is slated to be closed. The students vow to go all out to make this final cultural festival a success.

The Astronomy Club of the protagonist Sou Akiyama is filled with the big names on campus. Just before the festival on October 1, the club receives a request from the student executive committee to calm the uneasiness among the students. There are reports of ghost sightings, accidents, sleeping sickness, and other mysterious incidents at the old building. When Yui Furukawa, a quiet girl who transfered late into the school, appears before Sou, the gears of fate slowly begin to move.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: À la recherche du futur perdu
In Search of the Lost Future

title.native: 失われた未来を求めて

112630.description:
The story stars two-time winning sumo wrestler Takarayama. After his successes, he believes that he'll be promoted to yokozuna, the highest rank in sumo wrestling. Instead of receiving his promotion, Takarayama finds himself summoned to another world by magician sisters Elise, Iris, and Franca, and they don't know how to send him back. In the meantime, the magical trio is hungry, so Takarayama starts making a pot of Chankonabe (a traditional stew that sumo wrestlers eat).

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 異世界ちゃんこ ～横綱目前に召喚されたんだが～
title.romaji: Isekai Chanko: Yokozuna Mokuzen ni Shoukan sareta n da ga

112631.description:
The manga follows Makoto, a young boy who gains superpowers due to an evil gene manipulation experiment. Makoto and other youths join the Avengers as apprentices named "Future Avengers." It will show Makoto and others as they train, fight villains and grow, under Avengers members Iron Man, Captain America, Hulk, Thor, and Wasp.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: マーベル フューチャー・アベンジャーズ

112632.description:
Kanade-kun and I broke up at graduation. that's what I thought, but we met again in high school...? Are we going to keep this a secret still?

Note: Includes the one-shot "Aoi Love Letter (青いラブレター)".

112633.description: A naked boy is born from an egg! “Sore,” which does not speak, seems to be born from a person's craving and embodies that craving…. A bizarre high school student's diary of high school student Tasuku Masaki, and Sore who follow him around!

112634.description:
Sachi Usui is a 27-year-old office lady with poor luck in life. She's so busy with work that she's resigned herself to having instant noodles and other unhealthy food from convenience stores for dinner every night. One day as she's stocking up on instant food from the convenience store, a guy from a group of three men asks her "Can you really get energy from that kind of food?" These men are actually from Ensenji Temple, where the head priest Gendou is an amazing cook. The next day, Sachi meets the guy again, and he invites her to go flower viewing at the temple.

Moved by the Buddhist cuisine that they treat her to and their words of encouragement, Sachi finds herself inspired to cook with fresh ingredients from the supermarket for the first time in a long time. Sachi continues visiting the temple to learn more about cooking, and her state of mind and lifestyle start slowly changing.

(Source: Clairparfait)

112635.description:
Shirayuki, Alice goes to a high school that teaches one how to become a princess. Once you learn how to act like a lady you can be the next Briar Rose, alongside your prince entitled Royal road.

When Alice was a little girl, she made a promise with a boy who told her he would become her prince and lead her to become a princess. However, she's forgotten his name and what he looks like, but she won't give up until she finds her prince and becomes the next Briar Rose! At the school she meets two upperclassmen—one, a seemingly nice Prince named Subaru and the other a more aloof Prince named Kyouya. Both end up being Alice's pair in trying to teach her how to be the next Briar Rose but jealousy and evil plots begin to fall upon Alice in her journey. Who can she trust when things don't appear as they seem!?

(Source: LuffyNoTomo) EditBackground

title.native: 先パイ、教えてください

112636.description: Tells the story of Akhilleus (a.k.a. Achilles) in Greece, before the Trojan war. But, in a twist, this Akhilleus is a busty woman who fights in sexy bikini armor. She fights with Agamemnon, who is in the process of extending his dominion through Greece.

title.native: アキレウス アルゴスの軍神

112637.description:
Panda's Hole, an organization that abducts beautiful girls and trains them as idols: the story unfolds on a lone island on the sea!

(Source: Amazon)

112638.description:
Throughout Japan, the enthusiastic sports battle "ARTEMIS" takes place to decide the strongest teenage girls! One of the stars, "Shinigami" Minowa Osamu, has transferred to Tokyo Metropolitan High School with regained power as the last hope to reach the top of ARTEMIS.

(Source: Amazon, translated)

112639.description:
Despite cooking up mouth-watering entrées as a master chef, Kijun is still a vampire that thirsts for human blood. Lucky for him, the young girl who was his “first bite” has stumbled into his restaurant, and into his trap! Finally after 25 years Miro will be his to enjoy once again, but… her blood tastes terrible! What has she been eating?! Time for Chef Hong to put his culinary skills to good use: to lavish her with delicacies and prepare a most succulent meal for himself!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: ヴァンパイア・シェフ

112643.description: Naoki Urasawa's Solo Mission follows an intimate conversation between a tokusatsu hero & his wife before a deadly intergalactic mission.

112644.description: In a world where kaiju actually exist, French kaiju otaku Pierre travels to Tokyo hoping to see one in person. There he meets beautiful government scientist Misaki and together they learn why kaiju travel to and attack Tokyo every year since 1954, despite first appearing down in the southern islands.

112645.description: The second story in this collection is about a journalist. As a child he met a fortune teller who predicted that he would win the famous Pulitzer Prize. The prophecy is very specific, he must have an apple in his pocket, go twice to the right instead of left and aim for the moon. A phrase that makes little sense to the young boy. It is only decades later, when he has become a poor journalist in charge of obituaries, that he sees that the medium of his childhood has announced his death in a few days. Curious, he goes to investigate and finds himself embroiled in a dark money deal. The strange indications of the psychic could well make sense...

112646.description: The mouse Henry tries to stop his dimwitted lackey Charles from traveling all the way around the countertop to acquire cake, worried he will accidentally wake up the sleeping cat on the floor.

title.native: ヘンリーとチャールズ

112648.description:
Hajin Park doesn’t have much beyond a pretty face. He’s jobless, lives with an annoying roommate who watches porn on max volume, and has modest aspirations of opening an online store. His sister will help him achieve his dreams on one condition: if he gets autographs from the famous all male idol group Eight Nine. When he finds mega pop star Hangyum Lee pleasuring himself in a bathroom stall, it’s not just Hajin’s memories of their past together that gets stirred. A twisted romance lacking anything but love begins.

(Webtoon Database)

112650.description:
Kyoko and Miku are childhood friends attending the same high school. One day, Miku confesses to Kyoko that she loves her. Miku tells Kyoko that she doesn't have to respond right away, but she wants her to decide whether or not to have a serious relationship with they graduate. Until then, Kyoko can do or say whatever she wants to Miku. The story of Kyoko and Miku, a thrilling love experiment between two girls, begins...!

(Source: INKR)

112651.description:
Follows the struggles of Narumi Maruyama, a 24-year-old temp employee who is actually a blob-like alien from the planet Darudaru.

Notes: Nominated to the 23rd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.
synonyms: Daruchan ou la vie ordinaire de Narumi Maruyama, employée intérimaire

112652.description: Serious service and a gorgeous gaze - the story of a bank teller with no weak spots and no smiles.

112653.description:
Lokheun’s name means "happy morning," but her life takes a tragic turn when her mother is murdered and her father becomes a fugitive after exacting revenge. To save him, Lokheun devotes her life to Garyun, the dashing emperor who’s committed to right the wrongs of his father. Believing Lokheun to be a boy, Garyun is determined to mold her into an unsurpassed martial artist, even if it means sending her to hell. Their strained relationship turns into something more as Lokheun searches for the one thing she’s never had: a life befitting her name.

(Source: Tapas)

112654.description:
A charitable count offers to adopt young Kaidel into a life of nobility, and the orphan boy only has to pledge one thing in return: follow the "ember" and seek out the witch that set fire to his childhood village. Raised as a skilled fighter in a family of alchemists, Kaidel now sets out to find the white-haired witch. When he finally encounters a woman with flowing white hair, she is kind and gentle--contrary to the rumors spread by other villagers. Could the sweet Eleanor be the same witch from his nightmares? Between love and vengeance, which will Kaidel choose?

(Source: Tappytoon Comics)
synonyms: A Witch's Hope That Can't Be Fulfilled

title.english: The Hopeless Desire of a Witch

112655.description:
The great snow-covered kingdom of Bistron, legend has it that an evil witch lives in the Black Forest at the edge of the kingdom… That very witch, Veronica finds herself summoned by the ruler of Bistron through his messenger of noble blood, Ignatius.

(Source: AOC Translations)
synonyms: A Witch & the Knight of Noble Blood
The Witch and the Knight of Noble Blood

112656.description: The prestigious Arima family has an excellent butler. When the head of the family takes in an exotic-looking bastard-girl as a favor for his friend, it is up to the butler to tame her wildcat personality.
synonyms: しつじどののあいねこ

112668.description:
Uh-oh, River is in love with his oblivious best friend Sea... Will he confess to him during their grad trip? Perhaps... But little does River know that true danger lurks below still waters, waiting for him.

Freediving deep underwater, he spots a mysterious stranger chained to a ship at the bottom of the ocean. As local lore goes, vampires once roamed the lands until a bloody event changed everything.

Is River hallucinating? And just what is real? Take a deep breath... and dive in.

(Source: Tapas)

112669.description: An old MMORPG called Live Dungeon. Before the service was terminated, Kyotani Tsutomu made full use of 5 notebook PCs to clear the game and was invited to a different world. And then, Tsutomu was speechless when he saw a live relay of a dungeon capture in the different world. They bulldozed through without any thought of strategy. The misfortune of getting the healer position. Tsutomu reinstated the White Mage that had always been his favorite in games and aimed to conquer the dungeon to find the key to his escape from the different world.

1-3. Dutch Wife ni Tsukaretara (ダッチワイフに憑かれたら); Comic Aun 2016-10, 11, 12
4-5, 7. Choroimin (ちょろいみん, Easy Hypnosis); Comic Aun 2016-05, 06, kakioroshi
6. Ejikiu Kame wa Kyoubou de (餌食う亀は凶暴で); Comic Aun 2017-02

112673.description:
Learn what happened when the world turned to stone in this special side story to Dr. STONE. As Senku and his friends are being turned to stone, his father Byakuya is on the International Space Station. This is the story of the crew as they try to survive as the only humans who remain flesh and blood!

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: DR. STONE Reboot: Byakuya - Tôi ở đây

112674.description:
Life becomes a nightmare for Skelly when the oddest cat they've ever seen arrives on their doorstep. It's definitely not the Persian cat they ordered... not only is it hairless, but it pees constantly and cries around the clock. As if the neighbors' complaints aren't enough trouble, the vet bills are sky high and nearly bankrupts the newly independent skeleton. But even a mutant cat deserves an owner-- and so, Skelly struggles to fill the shoes of a cat dad with the help of an alcoholic succubus and a devil priest. Meanwhile, a mysterious demon notices their unique pet and wants to steal it for sinister reasons. Can Skelly protect their new cat from kidnappers and other threats within the Devildom, let alone handle living together with it?

(Source: TappyToon)
synonyms: 骸骨、ベビーシッターになる

title.english: The Skeleton Becomes a Cat Dad

112676.description:
Tatari Kamino is a shy but kind middle school student possessing magical powers. She wants to make friends, but is bullied by her classmates because they find her gloomy and stupid. Pushed to her limit, Tatari sends cruel curses to her classmates in order to seek vengeance. A true horrific and disgusting shoujo manga full of kindness!

(Source: Delcourt/Akata)

title.native: 不思議のたたりちゃん
復讐の王子と盟約の妃
title.romaji: Fukushuu no Ouji to Meiyaku no Kisaki

112678.description:
Accused of being a witch and a murderer, Evony’s imprisoned. For years, she awaits the day of her execution, her back bearing scars from beatings inflicted by the guards who despise her. But one day, she is granted her freedom and placed into the guardianship of Grand Duke Schneider. Warmed by his doting staff and under his admiring tutelage, she regains her strength and becomes the wild card in an intricate game of power. With nothing to lose, will Evony orchestrate a new future for the empire?

(Source: Tapas)

112679.description: “Shokatsu Koumei”, also known as Zhuge Liang. Among the few heroes that decorated the Annals of the Three Kingdoms, it was once a prestigious name. An account of “an ingenious tactician”, the thousand-year-old story of the “God of Stratagem”. It is said… “in a country torn by factions and transformed into a devastating and cruel hell, the heavens sought peace by sending a composed, well-loved young man of impeccable and divine virtues.” Well, well. In truth… He is a childish man.

112680.description: Kokoro Orihara would not ask any of her classmates to come to her place. That is because her papa has taken a doll for his wife. Because of this oddity, she wants no one to know about her family and she distances herself from everyone at school. That is, until one day Mizushima appears who understands her problem...

112682.description:
I will show you the way to make that popular guy falling in love with you.
"You don’t know me! Don’t be so pretencious!"
He is always in front of my eyes, making fun of me. He always sees me with that kind of face and it’s intolerably sexy! But even if I want to be honest with him, I can’t. At the next culture festival, I wonder if I can change that?
synonyms: Your Gesture Says I Like You

112683.description:
The "local heroine fighter" of a certain city became popular and a national star. Because of this, "local heroines" debuted in various other places, and their action live events became a hit trend nationally. In Hinano City, high school girl Misaki Shirogane and other girls become local heroines (at the urging of Misaki's aunt, the prefectural governor) and vow to produce action live events.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 bonus chapters.

title.native: アクションヒロイン チアフルーツ

112684.description:
Mabel’s been mocked her whole life for her nonexistent magical ability, but when she finally meets her true father, it’s the all-powerful archmage, Raquiel! Forced by an imperial pact to let her go long ago, he can now welcome her into his home, with his half-wolf butler, three nymph sisters, a fox halfling, and a kind disciple to watch over her. But dark secrets from his past threaten to catch up with them. Will his magic be enough to protect her? Could she even come into power all her own?

(Source: Tapas)

112688.description: All things created in this world have their own purpose. For some, their true purpose can only be served in death. A person's treasured possession can have a soul and take the form of a human, but what if they were to be abandoned? A masterless Object Spirit can only wander the earth until eventually they too turn to dust in the wind...

112689.description:
The source of undergraduate Meguro's worries are his straight friend, Akino, who falls in love too much for his own good. Even though he knows Meguro is gay, Akino will always end up hanging out at Meguro's place after being dumped by his girlfriend. "Nothing but your cooking, the smell of your room – and the touch of hard muscles will heal me!!" So saying, Akino pushes down Meguro to touch him all over, and on top of that kisses him and they jerk off together!! Their friends have all agreed, "You two are definitely going out!!" but the two are absolutely unaware...?!

112690.description:
"If I ever get brave enough to say I like you from the top of my lungs--"

Bessho coincidentally meets Makita in a university lecture they share, finding out that they both like cute things. While Bessho hides his preferences like a dirty little secret, Makita makes no excuses for who he is and what he likes. Despite the twists and turns they encounter along the way, the pair of lovers deal with their possessive and jealous urges on their slow journey to answering the age-old question: what is the best way to fall in love?

(Source: Manga Planet)

112693.description: Every time it's a climax!! All are songmakers! Adelite was married to the famous Hunt family from southern country to fulfill a promise her parents made. However, the bridegroom already had a wife and child named Pyrope and Corona. Still wanting to remain Hunt's second wife, Adelite eventually gave birth to his son, Pete. In the same year, Pyrope gives birth to his son, Cube. Cube has mysterious eyes that only a limited number of people possessed...

112694.description:
Junior high school student Amane lost her parents early and lives with her uncle Yuki-chan. Even though he had a faint feeling for Yuki-chan, she lived calmly for the same days, but one day, when she cut her hand with a book in the study, she summoned a devil from another world (very beautiful). Will call out. Amane has signed a contract with the devil (very beautiful) for Yuki-chan, but that's why she ended up being a "migration consultant from a different world for the devils suffering from population growth"...?

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

112696.description: The story of a detective attempting to solve a mystery and a man who doesn’t know himself.

112697.description: After his whole family was eaten as a child, Chikita Gugu is the sole survivor of the legendary Gugu clan. Now he's a teenager and people are coming to him for help, even though he has no training or ability! Luckily he's not alone. Laa Lam Delal, the youkai who killed his family, is watching over him, waiting for him to ripen...

A collection of shorts stories drawn by 10 popular manga artists. The theme is "The End of the World".
What is the "end" drawn by each artist?

112702.description:
A top killer from the 21st century accidentally became a loser empress through time travel, and got an extremely handsome husband and a cute genius baby. She gradually figured out that to dominate the imperial harem, she must hone her skills both at cooking and at pleasing the emperor. With her pot and spoon and assisted by a spirit chef system providing her with handy equipment any time, she finally swept the emperor off his feet, took hold of the harem, and reached the pinnacle of her life!

(Source: WebComics)

112709.description:
The Quincies' Thousand Year Blood War is over, but the embers of turmoil still smolder in the Soul Society. Tokinada Tsunayashiro, elevated to head of his clan after a slew of assassinations take out every other claimant to the title, has a grand plan to create a new Soul King. His dark ambitions soon sow the seeds of a new total war across the realms, but all is not lost. There is one unlikely Soul Reaper who holds the key to defusing the conflict—Shuhei Hisagi, Assistant Captain of the Ninth Company and reporter for the Seireitei Bulletin!

(Source: VIZ Media)

112711.description: Sanae promised Riku, whom she loves, her virginity when she turns 16 and today is the day. But everything changes when on her 16th birthday, the day of their promise, Riku falls in love with a woman whom he saves from drowning.

112712.description:
Kawai Karii is a student and a cosmetic maniac. It's her daily task to hide her simplistic look by applying a lot of make-up. And now the destined encounter is about to take place--she meets up with Uzura, who is also a big fan of cosmetics and has even nicknamed himself "Make-up Man". It's now time for a new school term. Karii has become very depressed because her real look was exposed to the public when the school performed a clothing check*. Yet she was cheered up by Uzura's one kind sentence... This is a pure love story, presented to you by our Mamoru-kun!

*Note: Japanese schools usually perform a clothing check at the beginning of each new term to make sure that every student follows the dress code.

(Source: Shoujomagic)

112714.description: Manga series based on the "The Future Is Wild" documentary series as well as the "The Wild World of the Future" book.

112715.description: After Dean, a third rate adventurer, got surrounded by demonic beasts in the demonic labyrinth, he fled to a place where he found the strongest demon who devours power: The demon-fed sword Belzera, born to the Gluttony Empress Belzebuth. After obtaining such unexpected power, he once again aims to become a first rate adventurer he looked up to, and delves deeper into the labyrinth. However...

title.native: あなたに傍にいてほしい
title.romaji: Anata ni Soba ni Ite Hoshii

112720.description:
Things lost, Born anew, as love. The most painful love story in the world. “If it’s only for half a year, I’ll date you.” Kasuya was a difficult partner, Mio suggested that kind of relationship. It was supposed to be a real game plan, but Tomadou Kasuya became serious right away. Before long though, Mio found out that she has “juvenile Alzheimer” disease…

(Source: Manga Abyss)

112722.description:
General store manager Akio lives a carefree live in Okinawa with his dog, Kafu. One day he receives a strange letter from a woman named Sachi, but that’s not any person he’s familiar with. It turns out that the letter was a response to a joke wish he hung up at a Shinto shrine months earlier. Then one day, Sachi shows up and the two begin a relationship.

(Source: Nipponcinema)

112725.description:
Adaptation of a popular novel.

Five years after the Tokugawa shogunate collapsed—- Kizou is the dour, misanthropic owner of a used-goods store. One night, out of the blue, the demon Koharu wanders into his house, having gotten separated from his group of wandering spirits. Koharu impudently assumes he can stay there for free, and Kizou unwillingly relents. The two of them wind up getting involved in the affairs of various spirits… A story of empathy among spirits during the Meiji era that will move you with kindness.

112727.description: Lampo, a boy living in a port town on the Evlian Peninsula, meets Yoshino, a girl protected by a robot that fell from the sky while he was fishing. She is a priestess of the Jehuan Kingdom says that she cannot return to the Kingdom of God until she finds out the true intentions of her attendant Taihou, who took her away, but the Kingdom's army arrives on the peninsula to bring Yoshino back.

112729.description: My name is Ginga, 14 years old. For me right now, all girls are cute and of course "ecchi" is very interesting. But Arisa who I met at the library is the only one who I could see is different. And then her secret was revealed... I want to know boys' real intentions - a touching first love story presented to you.

112731.description: The two are female teacher and her student but they are Engaged! Nano is a popular teacher who is admired by students. Only Souji, a male student, gives her trouble. One day, someone she knows introduced her for an arranged marriage. Nano is worried at first, but later became frank with the man who she meets and is in a good mood. Later she realized that the man is Souji disguised as someone else! Even though she rejects the arranged marriage, Souji still comes to pursuit her. Will Nano, the Serious teacher, be able to reject Souji's love?

title.english: My Matchmaking Partner Is My Student and a Troublemaker
title.native: お見合い相手は教え子、強気な、問題児。
title.romaji: Omiai Aite wa Oshiego, Tsuyoki na, Mondaiji.

112733.description:
Satsuki and Haruka grow up together. Satsuki always looking after Haruka, who is lethargic and lazy, but somehow charms girls. One day, Haruka, half asleep and dozy reaches over to Satsuki and… 5 Bittersweet heartthrob love stories!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

A collection of one-shots:

2. Milk
3. Clear Color
4. Goodbye Daisy
5. Lucky Strike

Based on a true story.

In 1923, Osaka was gathered at Plato's "Kuraku" editorial department. In the center of the youth, Kawaguchi Matsutaro, Naoki sanjūsan (later Naoki Sanjūgo). The desire to draw a part of Japan literary history in the late Taisho period and early Showa era.

112737.description:
An office lady in her thirties who works in the secretarial department, Aina Tanaka, is engaged to a rich heir and was supposed to have a smooth sailing life. However her fiancé suddenly dumped her for a junior colleague. Trying get over the breakup, she got drunk and collapsed on the street. Then she was saved by a young man... and they ended up spending the night together!

She was worried about having committed a crime, but the young man, after having heard of her plight, said he's about to turn 19 and offered to marry her under an arranged contract. Aina wanted to let her ex-fiancee think that she'd moved on, so she agreed...

But on their wedding night, it turned out that the young man was an unexperienced virgin...?

(Source: Amucomi, translated)
synonyms: A 19-years old husband has a secret

title.romaji: 19-sai no Otto ni wa Himitsu ga Aru

112738.description:
Based on the erotic game by Black Backage.

Shinji Oohashi is a part-time launderer since one month. He's working for Asai Cleaning under Sayaka, a rather young widow.

While trying to gain the heart of his employer, Shin-chan doesn't miss an occasion to mess around with the housewives of his neighbourhood, especially with Mari the hot chick from Bangkok!

112739.description: In the warring states era, the princess of Echizen Yukiyotani, a luxurous place named the 'Northern Capital', Rokka encounters a ninja named Kohaku. A brilliant warring state romance drawn by a passionate storyteller.

112741.description:
With her jet-black hair, sinister smile, and silent demeanor, Sawako “Sadako” Kuronuma always had trouble fitting in during high school. But with help from her friends, her boyfriend Kazehaya, and even her rival-turned-friend Kurumi, Sawako came out of her shell. Now in college, Sawako and Kurumi have become incredibly close, but Kurumi longs for a romance of her own.

Despite considering herself unlovable, and despite feeling deeply satisfied with Sawako’s companionship, Kurumi decides to put herself out there and try dating. When she’s pestered by a persistent suitor after a party, a handsome stranger comes to her rescue. He looks suspiciously like Sawako…or not so suspicious, considering that he is actually Sawako’s cousin! When Kurumi starts to feel drawn to him, could it be love?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

ฝากใจไปถึงเธอ ตอนพิเศษ ภาคเนื้อคู่พรหมลิขิต

title.native: 君に届け 番外編～運命の人～

112743.description:
Botan, an elementary student, lived with her ill mother, Sakura. Botan's father passed away in a car accident. One day a strange man named Miyuki appeared in their lives and her mother married him. Even though Botan hated Miyuki for ending her time alone with her mom, Botan accepted him for her mother's sake. Later on, Botan overheard Sakura and Miyuki's conversation and found out her real father was Miyuki after all.

Sakura's illness worsened until she died. Miyuki, having lots of debt from a failed business, decides he doesn't want Botan to have a hard life and tries to leave her behind. But Botan declares that they can never seperate and their new lives as vagabonds begins.

title.native: だから牡丹が好きやねん

112744.description: Part-time hotel receptionist Phoebe and Greek multimillionaire Jed were crazy about each other. He embraced Phoebe and wrapped her in love and happiness. One day Phoebe discovers she's pregnant and joyfully reveals the news to Jed. But his reply is unexpectedly cruel -he says there's no man in the world who would want a pregnant mistress! In shock, Phoebe has a miscarriage and vanishes from Jed's life. But five years later, he suddenly reappears!

112747.description: The hotel where Erin works has finally found a buyer…but it’s her old flame and former boss, hotel mogul Cristophe Donakis. She was his devoted worker and passionate lover, but as soon as he’d had his fun, he left her high and dry. Now he has Erin’s back against the wall. He claims he has proof that she stole twenty thousand pounds from the hotel he’d trusted her to manage, and Erin can’t prove her innocence. He says he’s willing to keep quiet on one condition… He wants to spend one last weekend with her!

112749.description:
"From today, you're my dog." The bright and bold Momota has been selected to be a personal secretary for their company's hot, young president who is notoriously known to be unrelentingly harsh and borderline dictatorial. Her days are now spent busily keeping up with the president's tough demands in her efforts to be his favorite dog. Until she finds out about the president's biggest secret, that is.

(Source: INKR)

112750.description: Kelly works as a nanny for a lovely family, and when they go on vacation, she gets a bit of time to herself at their house in Italy. Her relaxation time by herself is cut short, however, when a stranger walks up to her with a tire iron. Is he a criminal, a sailor or someone else? Turns out Kelly will have to quickly learn the life of royalty, because he’s Count Gianfranco Maldini!

112751.description:
When Ann takes a trip to settle her aunt’s estate, she finds out that her aunt had a dark secret.

Note: Published in Monthly Flowers 2019-10

title.native: ３分間の魔法～忘れられた小さな私～

112754.description: Mao, who likes plants and does things at his own pace, has been enrolled into the prestigious European-influenced boarding high school! He becomes friends with his mixed roommate, Louis, and might become entangled in a romance with a mysterious beauty.

112755.description: Normal high-school student Tateishi Kaoru's girlfriend is the popular idol Inui Yuki. After school, Kaoru finds Yuki entering a love hotel with another man. The recent prostitution rumors linger in the back of his mind as he chase after her, but he had to know the truth. As he encounters the gigantic man who seems to be stalking Yuki, he begins to uncover the mysterious powers surrounding his girlfriend.

112756.description:
Leon, a clergyman, is turned into a vampire by Lord Lucifer, the lord of a dark castle. In hope of reclaiming his humanity, he challenges his fate but things do not go as planned.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

112765.description:
A collection of stories:

1. KISS; Margaret 2012 #24
2. Kimi to Shitai Koto (君としたいこと); Margaret 2012 #12
3. LOVE'n'HATE; Margaret 2012 #16
4. Momoiro Hiji (桃色秘事); Margaret 2012 #19
5. Himitsu no Suki (ひみつのすき); The Margaret 2012-08
6. Ouji-sama ni Naru made Matte (王子様になるまで待って); Margaret 2022 #22
synonyms: 王子様になるまで待って

112766.description:
High schooler Nozomi Koiwa wakes up and discovers she's lost her memories...and a whole lot of height. Now the size of a soda can, she flees from a feline assault into the disgusting den of Yume Okubo, a drunken shut-in NEET who's terrified of people and hasn't been outside for months. Between falling beer cans and deadly insect traps, Nozomi survives long enough to convince the airheaded Yume that she's a figment of her imagination who's come to save her from hitting rock bottom...all while investigating how she ended up funsized. But despite their differences—height, brains, and otherwise—each half of this quirky combo might just be what the other needs!

(Source : Kodansha USA)
112766.hashtag: #小さいノゾミと大きなユメ

title.native: 小さいノゾミと大きなユメ
title.romaji: Chiisai Nozomi to Ooki na Yume

112770.description:
Da Silva Castle, near Salamanca, is a great location for a movie shoot, which is why it’s currently hosting a medieval production starring Lexie Anderson. The young actor is to share some steamy scenes with her heartthrob costar, but she just can’t find any on-screen chemistry with him. The movie drags on without her truly investing in the role until she explores the castle around the set and runs into Cesar Da Silva, the owner of the property! A young and reclusive heir, Cesar has made it his life’s goal to live quietly and out of the eyes of the press. When he and Lexie meet, two worlds collide: that of a woman who feels she can’t love a man and is constantly in the news, and that of a man who’s sworn off women and made an art form of dodging the media. Can these two leads find a common narrative, or will their love story wrap before it even begins?

Part 3 of the Femme Fatale no Musuko-tachi series.

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: 憂鬱な城主　ファム・ファタールの息子たち　III

title.english: When Da Silva Breaks the Rules

112771.description:
Why is he? Why is Luc Sabbatini here!? Two years ago, Luc - son of the famous hotel tycoon - used and dumped me, to him just nobody. He's reappeared in my life again and asked me out on a date by blackmailing me and exploiting his power. I thought I had no feelings left for Luc but?the little things he does have rekindled my blind heart. I have to be strong. I have a big secret, one he can never find out. If he does find out, there will be even worse misery than what happened two years ago.

(Source: Harlequin)

112772.description:
Laurence, Ruby’s friend, confidant and father figure, has passed away, and his son Zane has shown up suddenly while she’s still grieving. Zane ran away from home a while ago and hasn’t contacted anyone since. Upon meeting Ruby, he immediately hates her. Zane believes that Ruby was his father’s mistress. She is confused at first by his cold demeanor, but quickly realizes that he has misunderstood the situation. Even while she mourns his father’s loss, she tries to resolve their misunderstanding. Will she be able to get the intractable Zane to change his mind about her?

(Source: Harlequin)

112773.description:
Just sitting in the passenger seat of Rafaele’s car is enough to make Samantha feel like he owns her again. Four years ago, she fell passionately in love with the wealthy CEO of a luxury car company. Samantha ended up pregnant, but Rafaele saw her as nothing more than a fling and ended their relationship before she could tell him. She thought she’d never see him again, but here she is sitting next to him. When he sees her son, he instantly realizes that the child must be his. Lashing out in anger that Samantha hid his child from him, Rafaele sets out to use his money and power to make life as difficult as he can for her. But what does he really hope to gain from this?

Part one of the Femme Fatale no Musuko-tachi series.

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: 恋の罪、愛の罰 ファム・ファタールの息子たち I

title.romaji: Koi no Tsumi, Ai no Batsu

112774.description:
Model Alysha has been selected to become the face of a major cosmetics company’s new campaign. When it turns out that the campaign’s renowned photographer is Ross, she is forced to confront an unpleasant memory from five years ago. Back then, Alysha was a country girl who longed to be a supermodel—she barged into Ross’s studio and bribed him into doing a camera test for her, but the price was steep and continues to haunt Alysha. After that humiliating first meeting, why on earth would Ross choose to work with her now?

(Source: Harlequin)

112775.description:
Clio spent her university days surrounded by an elite group of four young, brilliant boys. However, since graduating she’s been faced with setback after setback in the real world. When success eludes her, she decides it would be better to at least be the wife of a man who is successful. And so she gets engaged to Jackson, a successful man with a despicable character. After she’s betrayed by him, Clio, lost and bewildered, finds help in the form of Stefan, her close friend from college. Though he scoffs at her present condition, he reaches out his hand and lends her his assistance. Clinging to his outstretched hand, Clio can’t possibly know that she’s making the worst decision of her life!

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: Okuman Chouja no Tsuma no Nedan
億万長者の妻の値段　大富豪の結婚の条件　III

112776.description:
Career-oriented Mallory is the executive of a cosmetic company. She goes to Lisbon on vacation and, the day she arrives, saves the life of a little girl. The girl’s father, Rafael, is the representative of a distinguished family, the D’Afonsos. He is arrogant and coercive and…unbelievably handsome. He is also looking for somebody to take care of his daughter. But when Mallory accepts the job, she finds out that he also expects her to marry him!

(Source: Harlequin)

112777.description:
Nadia plans to buy her country peace with her purity.

Princess Nadia believes offering her virginity to King Zayed, a long-standing, hostile enemy of her country, is the best way to forge peace between their countries. And so Nadia disguises herself as a dancer and infiltrates the king’s chambers. Here she will seduce the king, who is rumored to be a vulgar man. As pure Nadia trembles in his bed, the king finally appears, but he’s dignified and good-looking—completely different from his terrible reputation! Now what will become of Nadia’s plan? What will become of Nadia?

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: Taka O to Junketsu No Odoriko

112778.description:
They will face each other again with secrets in their hearts…
After graduating from college, Rachel is returning to her hometown. She’d lost her parents when she was young, and when she was still a child, her aunt and uncle decided to murder her for the insurance money. Fortunately, a beautiful man saved her life, promising her that she was not alone, that she had him. The man shared his name with a legendary vampire from the area, and when she grew up, Rachel decided she would seek out the enigmatic man who’d saved her life.

(Source: Renta!)

112779.description:
Gwen Sawyer, a popular decorum instructor among upper-class girls, is hired to be a live-in tutor to the daughter of the distinguished Harrison family. The family is headed by Will Harrison, who is the CEO of HarCorp…and Dallas’s most eligible bachelor. However, on their first meeting, Gwen finds him to be an arrogant man who thinks money can solve everything and who only sees women as things. Gwen is determined to teach him some manners, too, but she has no idea what a dangerous man she is trying to deal with!

(Source: Harlequin)

112780.description:
Alessandra needed to confess the truth to Christian Marcos, a handsome European billionaire. In the midst of the bustling party, she is able to find him immediately. Ever since she was a young girl, she has adored him and secretly call him Adonis, after the beautiful Greek god. And her dream did come true for an all-too-brief time—they spent just one night together. Now, even though Christian has never truly loved her or anyone else, Alessandra must tell him that she’s pregnant… Desperately in love with a man beyond her reach, she’s falling deeper and deeper into desolation!

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: アドニスの冷たい抱擁　大富豪の結婚の条件 2
アドニスの冷たい抱擁 大富豪の結婚の条件 Ⅱ
Adonis no Tsumetai Houyou - Daifugou no Kekkon no Jouken II

title.native: アドニスの冷たい抱擁

112781.description:
Princess Marisa of Bengaria recently lost her twin brother. Enveloped by a huge sense of loss, she decides to take a trip to Brazil. There she meets international businessman Damaso. His eyes seem able to sense Marisa's lonely solitude. Her attraction to him leads them to spend a passionate night together, but he walks out on her the next morning. One month later the newly pregnant Marisa finds Damaso before her yet again, insisting that they get married. What is he talking about? After cruelly abandoning her one month ago, he wants to get married?

(Source: Harlequin)

112782.description: Having won a photon sword in a mini-game, Yui decided that it would be the perfect gift for Kirito. However, convinced that a present is more impactful when it's delivered as a surprise, Yui enlisted the help of Asuna and the other girls. The girls would face Kirito in battle during a new GGO event and create an opportunity for the perfect surprise: using slime guns to blind him during the fight, thus allowing Yui to present her gift to the unsuspecting Kirito just as he regains his vision. However, Yui did not foresee one thing: that her surprise gift will have to compete in impactfulness with Kirito's mastery at getting himself into all kinds of ecchi situations...
