112783.description:
After Leila’s mother died, her stepfather kept her locked inside for two years. Her only dream was to escape from her stepfather and live as a free woman. And she may get her chance now that her stepfather has ordered her to marry Joss Carmody, a wealthy businessman! But Joss is suspicious and believes she’s only after his money. At first, they have a very cold relationship as husband and wife, but then one fateful kiss ignites a fire in their hearts. Leila begins to dream of a future together, but Joss doesn’t believe in love, and she begins to wonder… Does he even want her?

(Source: Harlequin)

He'll say things like, "I'm hard. Take care of it," with the cutest look on his face. In another moment, he approaches her like a wild beast... Lin Hai used to be an ordinary college student, until he was added into a WeChat group where immortals made deals. From then on, his life has totally changed. The Queen Mother ran out of her facial masks? Ten peaches of immortality in exchange, no bargain. Daode Tianzun wanted some cigarettes? Ten Elixir Pills, no credit. The Red Boy craved for a bottle of Wahaha, a Chinese drink? Come on, give me your Samadhi Fire! Chang’e would like to wear sexy lingerie? Oh my, it’s a tricky case. I need to take her measurement in person. Yama wanted to buy a new sports car? Wait, was I associated with the underworld now? Well, bring me the Book of Life and Death, and check my name off...

112798.description:
Rio, the school nurse at a junior high school, receives a mysterious phone call. She thought it was just a prank call at first, but then she finds out the true meaning of the message....

Junior high, where the teacher holds absolute power over the students. The teacher can invade their private space, and no one will bat an eye. The students themselves are still unstable and immature. Despicable sexual harassment and assault occur within the school environment because of these factors. Rio learns of one such incident that once took place at her school, and discovers that the same horrific act is now playing out once again. Rio's position as the school nurse, the closed-minded nature of the school's management, and the victims' attempts to hide the shame… all are obstacles standing in her way. This is the story of Rio's solitary struggle to stop the cycle of abuse, and to save those who have been victimized!

(Source: Kiss Comic, translated)

112801.description:
Once upon a time, there was a man whose lover, a psychic, was persecuted and died. The man wanted to create a world where psychics could live normal lives, so he created a virus that would turn ordinary people into psychics and spread it around the world. This is the world the man dreamed of. A world where 40% of humanity is psychic. A world where psychics live normal lives...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

112804.description:
In her first life, she was a Japanese college student who was raised in a family that favored physical prowess. In her second life, she was reincarnated into another world (not an otome game) as an orphan from the slums. She became hailed as the country's prophet, teaching several students who grew up to be some of the country's top elites. In her third and current life, she was reincarnated as a daughter of a noble family.

Born with the beauty and wealth she hoped for, she had thought that this time she would be able to live freely collecting cute things and indulging in fashion, things she was unable to do in her first life as she feared that they did not fit her. However, she discovered that not only had she been reborn into the same country where only 10 years had passed, but her father was her apprentice and her mother was the one who ran her over and killed her in her second life. Before her death, she had seen four futures in which she would get rejected by different guys and another one where she would be killed. Remembering this, she made a resolution to experience a wonderful romance and hide her past as a prophet.
synonyms: The Great Prophet Is Running from Her Previous Life ~I Want to Live a Rose-Colored Life After Reincarnating a Third Time as a Duke's Daughter~

112806.description:
Suddenly summoned to another world, former office lady Fukuyose Mahiru becomes a lunchlady in order to cover her living expenses, as well as gather information. Then one day, she gets her hopes up when she hears a rumor that the genius Magician Randy may hold a hint to help return her to her original world——.

"To find the practitioner than summoned you here, we must uncover the motives behind it."

Things become messy after it's determined Mahiru holds a great amount of magical power, and must therefore cohabitate with Randy?! And on top of that, he finds eating to be too troublesome, making him the ultimate picky eater——!

112809.description: Kashima Kaoru is an office worker who lacks love experience and works in the sales department of an electronic equipment manufacturer. While spending her busy days, she was alone and celebrated her 30th birthday. Then, in front of her, a handsome guy suddenly appeared as Alex from his favorite smart speaker. Declares that “I will probate probation and provide guidance on life” until she meets her fateful partner. From that day, two people will live together. The series will be updated every Thursday.

112810.description:
Long after the fall of humanity, the world lies in ruin. Factions of autonomous war machines, monstrous biological weapons, and other horrors of a bygone era battle it out in the remains of the society that created them, their conflicts endless and seemingly meaningless—until, that is, a machine finds its own meaning in the form of a human child. That machine, Humanoid Mobile Weapons Unit Number Ten, develops a fiercely protective bond with the child, and soon the two of them set out on a journey together. Their mission: to search for other human survivors, to deliver the child to her people...and to enjoy the trip for all they’re worth!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

112812.description: Hikari is a high school girl full of curiosity that lives surrounded by her favorite people and things. She leads an exciting life, and thanks to a strange turn of events, she becomes interested in the “Disinterested Prince” (Kyoumi LESS Ouji), a boy that doesn’t show any interest in people or things in general. And although he said "Isn't it just annoying to get involved with strangers?” He sometimes looks lonely, making Hikari’s desire to know more about his world grow…

The more you chew, the sweeter it gets

112813.description:
Following her mother’s passing, Midori is now not only responsible for raising her little brother, Ai, but she’s also tied down by housework and other school commitments, making it hard to establish any form of social life... Until she meets a man in the courtyard at school. Will he change her life or will she change him?

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

At one time, a hero has been summoned to a different world in order to defeat the demon king. After the war stretching 3 years ended, the commendable hero slayed the demon king, and he was forcibly deported back to earth after being dismissed.
"Give me a break! Elves in addition to beast race, dwarfs and demon race. Even though I wanted to make a harem in the different world I saved! My dream will not come true on earth, where there is no magic at all."
Thus, the hero returns on his own. Without the blunder of being extradited to earth this time, he will build a harem of his own in a different world.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou)

In the "quintessential fantasy of sword and sorcery, and of humans and beasts," a wise king named Carliga and a hero named Jack are enmeshed in a conflict over the Holy Sword, a relic of a great war. The sword will once again bring together the ambitions of two great nations, and a woman bandit named Zety will also become involved in the conflict.

(Source: Anime News Network)

1920s, Shanghai.

A young spy, Nemo, is infiltrating a mysterious new settlement called the "Black Babylon". It is said that the Sphinx appears in this city, managed by Blackmore Corporation.

Two people join a mystery battle!

(Source: Amazon, translated)

112826.description: "Married and unmarried women are completely different beings". That's what Yukino Suzuki, 38 years old realized. She relutantely goes back to her home town to work, while dreading the possibility of meeting any old acquaintances. Then she runs into an old high school friend, Michiko, and gets even more irritated...

112828.description:
Due to an influx of sinners, the Ten Kings of Hell were granted heirs to support them in the future. The said ten heirs studied together since they were children and were now all grown up. A collection of stories on relationships among them: "Enma's Studies": Enma has always aced his studies, but their recent lesson about 'Eros' leaves him confused, so he asks the frivolous Sotei for help. "Byodo's Unfair Romance in All Fairness": Byodo has always liked Godo since they were children, but the latter has feelings for their other mutual heir, Toshi. Heartbroken, Byodo vents his feelings out to Taizan. "Shinko's Dilemma": Being the heir to the first seat has been a struggle for Shinko, who was known for his gentle nature, contradicting the imposing image of his father. One day, he meets the mysterious 'Blackhat,' to which he can't help but be drawn.

(Source: Futekiya)

112830.description:
The Tearmoon Empire has fallen. As the flames of revolution scour the land, the empire’s ever-selfish princess, Mia, is publicly executed by way of the guillotine...only to wake up in the past as her twelve-year-old self! The empire’s back, the revolution is a distant memory, and sweets are once again on the table! As the bloodstained diary she brought back with her proves, however, Mia’s memories of the future are by no means just a bad dream. All the horrors and indignities she experienced in that terrible timeline are bound to happen all over again... That is, unless she can shape herself up, recruit some allies, and exploit her knowledge of what’s to come to solve all of the empire’s problems before they spiral horribly (and lethally) out of control! Is Mia up to the lofty task of changing the future and saving her empire? Not even slightly, but it’s her only choice if she hopes to spare herself from a second gruesome end at the blade of the guillotine!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Tearmoon Empire Story: Beginning from the Guillotine, a Story of Reincarnated Princess Making a Turn Around

Regardless, in order to save a childhood friend who sacrificed her body to protect him, Touru spent twenty-five years developing the skill. Once completed, the skill could completely defy the world’s common sense. Touru, the girl, the naughty child they picked up in a back alley, and the old landlord lady join together as companions, setting out on an adventure to become heroes. A man who lived through the depths of despair decided to move forward and widen his horizons.

112834.description:
The story takes place in medieval Europe, where warriors from across the whole continent are embroiled in vicious duels to prove their might, with the victor being ordained by God.
Our point-of-view character Katrea is being viciously targeted by the victor of one of these duels in her hometown, whereupon a chance encounter brings her into contact with a small, black-haired Asian man who offers to fight to free her from her subjugation.

112835.description:
The harem manga centers on a young man whose mother who lives separately asks him to become a manager of a room-share apartment building, and take care of six older and pampered young women.

Meet Aimu Hanamichi, a young man who towers just over 2m10cm tall but has a heart as soft as a teddy bear.
He constantly battles stereotypes and the harsh judgements of others. Will Aimu learn to love himself the way he is, will he change, or will he drown in the pressure and misery of all the misconceptions surrounding him?

112842.description: 16 year old Kokonoe Choko leaves home to learn etiquette at a wealthy household. What she finds is that it is actually a salon where various artists (perverts) have been arranged to gather as it was her father's wish that she marry an artist. However, what they desire from her is not love, but her body. Sought after for their art, and unwilling to return home in fear of indulging in her feelings for her "brother," she can do nothing but give in as her heart is thrown into confusion.

112843.description:
Neal Fu is the most popular guy in the school. Gather up all the girls that like him and you can fill up a whole football field! But he himself is a cold and unemotional guy. Our heroine Shaina Mu is so lucky yet unlucky. She is the deskmate of Neal Fu, but because of this, she becomes the public enemy of all girls. Some bi*ches set her up even assault her. He finally gathers up enough courage to confess, but...

112848.description: April 1945, Okinawa. While Japan has been at war for some time now, the small tropical island of Japan still seems untouched by conflict. It is there that little Tomiko lives in joy and good humor, despite the absence of her mother. However, when the bombing begins and her father has to go to the warfront, her daily life changes. Now, she will have to survive... survive against all odds!!

112849.description: This one-shot was published in collaboration with Psoriasis Partners and Celgene to celebrate World Psoriasis Day (October 29th). It is also intended to help reduce the stigma surrounding the condition.

Takai Tsukasa might humbly call himself an armpit connoisseur–he really knows his stuff (the stuff being the beauty of women’s shapely armpits). But for all of his meticulous study, will he ever find pitch perfect pits? A careless wish on a magic ring gives him a chance to find out by summoning the most gorgeous woman alive–but said woman just so happens to be a demoness! In a classic case of “be careful what you wish for,” things are about to get sweaty and perhaps a little too hot for Takai to handle.

But one night, three things happen: one, he notices that one of his students has been having it rough lately, two, he sees an adult magazine that looks eerily similar to that same student, and three, the student himself just saw him peeking... Miyama promises he won't spread this incriminating pic on the internet, on one condition - Mr. Okada should spend the night with him. But will one night be enough?

This is the almighty Dogeza Manga!! Dogeza is the act of kneeling on the ground in order to prostrate oneself until the head touches the floor. It can be a form of gratitude, apology, or prayer! Experience the miracles it causes with the eccentric teacher, Ogami. He is the "Shaman", a man of spiritual and a man who kneels.

112864.description:
"Give yourself over to me... I'll teach you how to forget the things you don't like." While working part-time in violation of school rules, Aki meets Masami, a piano instructor with whom he soon starts to take lessons. Aki begins to depend on Masami, who seems gentle, kind, and accepting of him as he is. One night, after an argument with his father which results in a beating, Aki flees home and runs to none other than Masami. "I'm the only one who can understand your feelings, and I'm the only one who can comfort you," Masami tells him, drugging him and taking the free will from his body, stealing his innocence, and bringing him to climax. Is this who Masami really is? Aki is scared and doesn't want to believe the truth... but also can't leave him. A love addiction story between a delinquent high school student and the piano teacher who shows his true self...

(Source: BookLive)

112867.description:
"Their bodily fluids, sweet like nectar, will make you drunk."

Clad in the fragrance of depravity and death, these beautiful fruit twins spiral into madness once human sexuality rears its ugly head…

title.native: ママはスポーツドクター

112871.description:
Katsumi Namikawa (16), a super shy high school girl who blushes when reading romance manga and gets flustered when talking to boys, has managed to get herself a college boyfriend! Holding hands, celebrating birthdays, even showing up in a swimsuit - everything is a "first-time experience" in their relationship. It's an endless cycle of the embarrassment, annoyance, and thrills of love!

(Source: Harta Comix, translated)

112872.description:
Slutty crossdresser Yuki-chan's got a date at the beach with an older man.
They have a hot threeway with a part-timer who's just passing by!
Car sex with double d*cks! This is sex-loving Yuki-chan's best summer ever.

112873.description:
The manga centers on Shiori Kozono, a high school girl who leads a prim and proper everyday life. But one day, she follows her friend Miki into a club, and she finds a contest where girls use words as weapons. Shiori steps into the world of freestyle rap battles!

(Source: Anime News Network)

Life is like the glimmer of the stars: sometimes merry, sometimes subdued. From your first days on Earth as you discover the world, to the trials and tribulations of adulthood. When I was born, my mother named me Ruka. This is my ordinary, extraordinary life.

112878.description:
Momori and Eisaku dated in high school. But because of Eisaku's abhorrent behavior, they broke up after a short time...

Two years later, as Momori struggles to find a new love, Eisaku reappears before her. But the boy she remembers doesn't match the one she has in front of her. Could she have made the mistake of not seeing the real Eisaku? Would there still be time to start again?

112879.description:
Since his girlfriend was beaten to death by a biker gang, Yamato Souhei has driven himself to become stronger and better at fighting. He's newly out of juvenile detention, and his friend Kijima helps him get back into life with a new job. His strength will be useful for the bouncer organization "Back Drop," which will make use of his abilities to provide security for clubs and other places.

Before he even signs on with the company, though, he happens across a group of people beating a man to death. Yamato can't save the man, but he does see the face of one of the attackers. Along with his new job as a bouncer, it looks like Yamato has become involved in a dangerous cycle of violence.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

112881.description: There is a library in the void between the Heavens and Outer Space. This library has all the knowledge and wisdom gathered throughout the entire universe that ever was or ever will be, which is why it's called the Eternal Library. In this library, there is a girl aiming to become the Moon Path Librarian "Velvet", and her other goal is to read the first book of all time.

112882.description:
"I don't need ordinary friends."
This is the story of the boy Beank and the girl Rosa, living in an abandoned RV.

112883.description: The answer of the question about Rolant, Rosely and Arthur's lives after overcoming the Lord of Darkness is in this soft ballad.

112884.description: A collection of autobiographical one shots published with edition 12/2019 of Melody.

112885.description:
A skillful secretary by day and choosy cruiser by night, Su-Ha is a young professional who’s in search of some no-strings-attached action. He hasn’t had much luck lately, though, since a handsome face doesn’t always match what’s in a guy’s pants. This might be why he finds himself wondering about his dreamboat boss, Director Park Ji-Woon. But there’s no way he can mix business with pleasure… That is, until Ji-Woon and Su-Ha run into each other in the gay bar bathroom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

What frightens the young, handsome, gentle, and capable colleague is taking pictures? Will a reunion with an old acquaintance who now is his new boss uncover a hidden past? What will follow the meeting with a schoolmate? Is it a love triangle? Or a relationship to say goodbye to the past?

This is the story of Itsuki-kun, the class prez, spending time doing odd jobs together with the beautiful girl, Asanami-san. They spend time together in the cute-afterschool hours... but occasionally, a change occurs. When the topic comes to "Death"... she becomes extremely heated! Laying herself bare and lots of skinship! She transforms!! This is a slightly perverted love comedy where you can learn the ways to kill people with a pure and beautiful girl.

I, the empress, who is rumoured to sit upon the world, who is tyrannical, who snatches men and forces them to be concubines, have met my retribution... Those from my past have turned their backs on me, and I ended up falling into my 'enemy's' hands!

112896.description:
If you thought regular marriages were insane, wait until you see the contract Viola signed! Our heroine, the daughter of an earl, signed herself away in a marriage contract to an aloof duke, Cercis, in order to save her family from a lifetime of poverty. All of a sudden, Viola's life is turned upside down when she moves into the Fisaris family's manor and is left to negotiate her new life as a "show wife" in a world she had only ever caught glimpses of before. How will she shake things up at the Fisaris estate?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

112897.description:
On the verge of flunking out of Grand Swordcraft Academy due to his total lack of talent, Allen Rodol’s life goes from bad to worse when the class prodigy challenges him to a duel where it’s win or face expulsion. However, the night before his hopeless bout, a mysterious hermit grants Allen a button that will give him one hundred million years to train in an alternate reality when pressed. Allen not only gladly accepts the offer but also goes back for seconds, thirds, tenths even! With over a billion years of straight practice under his belt, the world is about to see what the “Reject Swordsman” can really do!

(Source: Yen Press)

The setting is Paris, France. One day, Ayumu, a junior high girl, finds herself wandering into a small shop. Inside, she discovers beautifully crafted bags, made by a shopkeeper of exquisite skill. Captivated by what she sees, she will embark on a journey to become a leatherworker herself! With delicate and beautiful artwork by Atsushi Mamado, immerse yourself in the streets of Paris and the scenes of an artisan's workshop as bags come to life.

(Source: Harta Comix, translated)

112899.description:
Hosono Akira loves the novel “14 Years Old” and its protagonist Tokiko.
On the day he enters high school, a girl named Hiiragi Tokiko appears, and she’s just like Tokiko. This is the story about the impossible meeting between the Reader and the Protagonist.

112901.description: In the eight volumes of the series, the mangaka choses some of the most famous operas of all times to tell their stories. The first two volumes deal withe the operas in Wagner's Ring Cycle, the third contains La Traviata, Rigoletto, Aida and so on, each o the volumes containing various operas, their actions being divided in acts following the staging tradition.

112902.description:
Yan Jing has always believed that there is nothing she can't do in this world until she meets her imperious boss...

(Source: Webcomics)

112903.description:
The masterpiece of Wagner's opera ""Ring of the Nibelung"" now comes as a Japanese comic! It is said that if one wears the ring made out of gold taken from the river of Rhine, one can rule the world. Only those who abandoned the joy of love can obtain the power to make the ring. Alberich who was reviled by the fairies of Rhine, cursed love itself and made the ring. The series is comprised in 4 volumes.

(Source: Creek & River Co., Ltd)

112905.description:
Junpei is happily snoozing away during his sister's ballet recital when a male ballet dancer steps onto the stage. Moved by the strength and skills the dancer displays, the boy discovers his love for this art.

But after a certain tragedy happens, he vows to leave his past behind and turn into the epitome of manliness. What will he do when his love for ballet reignites?!

112906.description:
Shize, who has been living a fugitive life in Japan, was summoned to another world. Finally found a place full of happiness she belongs to, she got married to the king and gave birth to an adorable baby girl. Suddenly the head Priest of the palace forced her to return to the earth?!
"You’re kidding me, sorry but I’m not going back!"

While running from the evil hands, Shize escaped from the palace but...?

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

112907.description:
The Yokai Watch series has caught on in Japan - this is the girls comic following Fumika (aka Fumi-chan) the female protagonist from the games.

The stories are original and sometimes show new origin stories for Yokai versus what was shown in the Shonen comic, but all draw on the pun-tacular characters and settings of the games, anime, and other manga.

112910.description:
The story is set in a town nestled in the mountains and centers on high school second-year student and aspiring musician Aoi Aioi, her older sister Akane Aioi, Akane's ex-boyfriend and struggling guitarist Shinnosuke Kanomura, and Shinno — who is actually Shinnosuke from 13 years ago after traveling from the past to the present. Aoi and Akane's parents passed away in an accident 13 years ago, and Akane gave up her ambition of going to Tokyo with Shinnosuke and decided to take care of Aoi. Since then, Aoi has felt indebted to her older sister. One day, she is invited to perform at a music festival as a session musician by a famous enka singer named Dankichi. At the same time, Shinnosuke returns to Aoi and Akane's town after a long time away. Then, Shinno mysteriously appears, and Aoi falls in love for the first time.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Le Bleu du ciel dans ses yeux

112912.description:
Surreal Cat Gags from Rie Arai, Creator of the Legendary Gag Manga “×―Peke―”! Sometimes a teacher, sometimes an idol, and sometimes a magical girl... Their very nature as cat or human, or even gender, remains a mystery. It's the elusive “Ms. Nekoyama”, who appears out of nowhere! These cat-filled gags are just what you need.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 新井理恵劇場 猫山さん

112913.description:
Exhausted from work and still recovering from the end of a five-year relationship, Suzaki swings by a nearby public bathhouse when his home bath breaks. Suzaki, much to his surprise, finds the public bath healing and starts visiting often. As he nurses his tired, naked body, Suzaki befriends Ken, an employee at the bathhouse....and notices Ken pays more attention to him than the other customers. Though Suzaki isn't interested in men, Ken's warming presence might make him think twice...

(Souce: Futekiya)

title.native: 湯気と誘惑のバカンス

112915.description:
When Kate unexpectedly ends up in another world, the one who rescues her is the supreme commander Arios, a man as overprotective as he is handsome. Everyday, he follows her no matter what... she can’t stand it anymore! In order to escape this new lifestyle, Kate ends up getting a job but...? The long-awaited slapstick romcom fantasy manga adaptation!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Circumstances of the Supreme Commander and I

112916.description:
Hyakujyou Academy is a boarding school with state-of-the-art educational facilities where all students are provided with smartphones and an Artificial Intelligence powered “Avatar” that supports their studies. However, this academy has another feature that makes it completely different compared to other schools, a “Penalty System” which punishes students if they don’t meet the academy’s strict performance targets!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

112917.description: Touhou Chireikiden focuses on Satori Komeiji's endeavors as a detective, solving mysteries around Gensokyo.

title.native: 東方智霊奇伝　反則探偵さとり

112919.description: Kisshioin Tsubaki, a beautiful lady reporter of the occult, wants to satisfy her intellectual curiosity by having a hands-on experience with every Yokai she can find. Follow her in her travels, accompanied by her trusted cameraman Yokomizo-kun.

112922.description:
It's the fifth anniversary of Rui Tachibana starting his career as a pop star. The girls love his younger bandmate, Hibiki Shinjo, because he's a man of few words and is very aloof, but he normally delights in bugging Rui. Their manager thinks it's sweet, like Hibiki's a little kid... Since Hibiki has a hard time getting up in the mornings, he sleeps over at Rui's one night before an early photoshoot. While Rui is taking a bath, Hibiki does an internet search for their names... even though they've been warned against doing just that. They find a very suspicious-looking, password-protected website, and they can't believe what they see!! In this fan-created manga, the two of them get up to such naughty things...! Rui's imagination starts running wild, and Hibiki makes a suggestion...

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

112923.description:
Upon his return from battle and a strange encounter with a monster-like man, The Captain is notified by his twin brother, The King, that their Guardian Deity no longer wants to protect the kingdom. To convince the Guardian Deity to change its mind, The Captain ventures out to its mountain lair and returns with the Guardian Deity's only condition to continue protecting the kingdom: The Captain must become his mate.

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Ryuu no Otto: Boukoku no Kami
Ie de Shoujo to Yoru no Shounen

112925.description:
Invincible gal, Kotobuki Ran. After graduating from high school, she continues to be an admired gal in Shibuya with her best friends Miyu and Aya!!

Aya and Otohata goes to the same university. Miyu gets married and goes to a junior college. Ran and Tatsukichi are on standby for the police recruitment exam...

Chaotic, full of passion, pure-hearted street ☆ the sequel of "GALS!" with grown-up girls has started!

112928.description:
Anko can't help but wonder about her always sleepy classmate, Yura. Just as she was fantasizing that perhaps he is a vampire... she learns that he really is (only 10%) one! After learning that Anko is a rareblood, Yura gets interested in her and suddenly says he loves her...!! But, are his feelings truly love?

This marks the start of this slightly vampire boy's daily approaches...!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

The one who saves him is a girl he had met by chance… The girl, whom Kiso is peculiarly drawn to, for some reason calls herself a "Demon's Burning Light"…?

This is a tale about a deliquent in Hiroshima named Sagawa Yoshi a.k.a. "Giccho." His legend started with his involvement in an annual event called the Demon Festival when he was a kid. The festival is an event where people disguise themselves as demons and roam around the town attacking children. Any kid who can defeat a demon will be recognized as a "man among men." However, only the kid who can defeat any of the 4 strongest demons - Hayabusa, Manba, Hanya and Sakura - will be considered a "true man among men." Will Giccho be able to defeat one of the strongest demons, given that even his greatest rival doesn't stand a chance?

A one-shot pilot manga, involving battles between more-or-less holographic Digimon. Just when it seems like peaceful everyday life will continue forever, disaster strikes, and that's when these men move to protect what matters most to them! A compilation of stories about the legendary boys of Hiroshima!

112944.description:
It began with a mistake. When Tanaka and Nakata are given each other’s papers back, they come to a horrible realization... They have almost identical names. And test results. And body types. And taste in fashion. And sports scores. And hobbies. The list goes on, and as annoying as it is, at least they know they always have each other. And maybe, just maybe, their similarities run even deeper.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

XXX kiss comedy, caused by the unique nature of the “witch”!

Yuu and Ren start living together as Beta friends. Yuu is secretly in love with the gentle & calm Ren. On the other hand, Ren feels the same way but can't put it into words. Is there a reason why he can't let Yuu know his feelings...

Is she just socially awkward, or does she have Asperger’s…? Yukiko Kodemaru can’t make eye contact when she talks, always acts overly self-deprecating, has low self-esteem, and seems to struggle with office work. But somehow Kinoshita ends up living with her…!? The start of living with a timid girl!

112949.description:
Kunieda Kei is a popular TV announcer known for being a cool and flawless professional. But on the inside, he’s the opposite: brash, hot-tempered, and as prickly as can be. Still, Kei juggles his private and professional personas successfully until one day, the unthinkable happens: stop-motion animator Tsuzuki Ushio from work sees him at the grocery store with his real personality on display! Now Kei has to figure out how to navigate a relationship he didn’t expect. But is that really as scary as the possibility that someone might love both sides of him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

112953.description:
After suddenly being confessed by a naive high-schooler, Hikaru, Ikuto "Maria" Maruya could not stop thinking about that awkward but unexpectedly strong boy. He doesn't want... to hurt his feeling. Although Hikaru is doing his best to get close to the mature Maria, Maria only think about Hikaru's feeling as temporary as young male puberty! Facing Maria who always avoids his feeling, Hikaru then decides to change his plan...

(Source: Manga.Club)

112955.description: This is a love story between 23 year old grad student Asahina Motoko and her 64 year old professor Sakaki Ikuo. Motoko is a very mature and serious girl with poor social skills and is often called dark and gloomy by her classmates. However she finds Professor Sakaki to be kind and easy to talk to, despite his reputation as a strict and scary teacher. Although Professor Sakaki tells Motoko that her feelings for him are not love, something is developing between the two of them, and it might change them both into better people.

112956.description:
When you get summoned to another world, things are supposed to go a certain way: become a hero, battle monsters, and slay demons, right? But when Kaito gets his summons, things are a little different. First off, he’s not even the hero…but it doesn’t matter, because the world he’s been thrust into is at peace. With nothing better to do, Kaito finds himself taking it easy in this unexpectedly mellow fantasy world. Now he can breakfast with its beautiful denizens, learn magic with the help of a spunky demon girl, go to barbeques, and so much more!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

112957.description: Maria, a Lehman who is a sharehouse resident and receives an ardent love call from Hikaru, a high school student. On the other hand, while he is a straight confession that seems to be a high school student, he is swayed by Hikaru because he is not shining or honest... The same is true for Maria who cannot be obedient, and as soon as he reexamines his feelings, things change one after another...!? Where is the love of the two people?!?

112959.description:
Inside this mansion is a paradise of girls! All the young maids are at the age when they want to explore new things, and Aira is among the youngest. When her friend Sophie acts secretive, Aira follows her and catches Sophie "fooling around" with another maid! In exchange for keeping it a secret from the head maid, Aira asks Sophie to fool around with her, too... However, it seems kissing isn't enough to satisfy Aira... As they bare themselves from under their uniforms, they begin to touch one another, and soon Aira and Sophie are heading towards the heights of pleasure!

(Source: Renta!)

112961.description:
"Aaaagh!" "I know your weak spot is your ears." The tough Hana, who's never lost a fight before, thinks her childhood friend, Takeru, is adorable! Even though he's grown much bigger than her, she's ready to protect her angel for the rest of her life...! But, Takeru's talking about how he's into "sweet and cute" girls! Maybe, it's time for Hana to become a little feminine...! She dresses up and is feeling good about herself because Takeru compliments her, but that doesn't last for long. Takeru gets kidnapped! She feels guilty she let her guard down... and goes to save him! A tomboy and an angel!? Where will this relationship go...?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter

"I won't hand you over to anyone, Yume." One day, Taiyo, a handsome delinquent, fell from the sky right in front of hard-core yaoi fan Yume. He's got a mean stare, blond hair, and he's terrifying... Then starts fantasizing about it... Then her foot slips, and... suddenly she's on top of his face... "Ah! Wait... No... If you move your lips down there, I'm going to... Nh! I can't take it...!" An overly earnest and pure punk boy and a perverted girl's comedic love story begins!

112967.description: “Do you like Novels”? By putting the most beautiful of words alongside each other, you can create a story that radiates with grace. Such masterpiece novels have the power to move people’s hearts… or at least that’s what Chitani Iciya hoped was true. For the young writer who debuted in middle school, his novels unexpectedly came under more and more criticism until his writing spirit broke. He’s the type of person who thinks that they could never possibly become a protagonist in any story. On the other end of the spectrum lies Koyurugi Shiina, a beautiful up-and-coming novelist that claims to have seen the God of Novels. Their paths collide as they contract to work together, starting the pair’s relationship as they each progress forward with the help of writing…

Ako is an office lady who works in Tokyo and she's soon to be married. Her fiance's father passes away and she decides to attend the funeral by herself, so off she goes to his hometown, which is on the in-land island of Shiojima. What she doesn't realize though is that behind her back her fiance's family is trying to prevent her from going back to Tokyo for some reason...

(Source: Clairparfait)

A food-centric manga about a man who has traveled the world over eating various cuisine for his job at a food specialty trading company. He then decides to set up a hamburger restaurant utilizing his experiences.

(Source: Anime News Network)

112976.description:
Cool and tomboyish Nagi wants a boyfriend, but has one big problem—ever since an incident in college, her body reflexively rejects the touch of any man. That is, until she encounters the beautiful male model Aran, who uses his androgynous look to effortlessly model both masculine and feminine styles. She’s shocked to discover that she can touch him without having a reaction, and when he asks her to join him in an upcoming photo shoot with a famous photographer, she agrees, on one condition—be her practice boyfriend for one month, and help her conquer her aversion once and for all. By the author of Such a Treacherous Piano Sonata!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

The ultimate spinoff of Record of Ragnarok!! Lü Bu was the first to fight for the mortals in the final battle between god and man, Ragnarok. The legends of his martial prowess are portrayed in this Three Kingdoms wuxia story.

A boy named Oowaki, and a girl, Yoshida, meet on Amigara Mountain, where an unsettling discovery has been made. Human shaped holes are scattered across the mountain, and it soon becomes clear that the holes are "calling" to the people they are shaped like. So what happens when they enter the hole? Well, you can be sure that massive amounts of claustrophobia and Nightmare Fuel are involved.

112981.description:
First year high schooler Junta Shiraishi is a mob character who goes unnoticed even when he's standing right next to you. But his classmate, "heroine-level beauty" Kubo, always notices him and is there to tease him. Anyone can become special to someone, but it might be a little too early to call these feelings "love." Perhaps this story is still two-steps from being a romantic comedy--let's call it a sweet comedy where a background character becomes visible!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Notes:

- Won 19th place (2020) and 7th place (2021) in the Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Awards in the physical release category.

Teru is a happy-go-lucky guy who works at an ice rink and loves to skate. While Ice Prince Naohisa Izumi's home rink is under refurbishment, he will practice at Teru's rink. Facing the pressure of being the child of a famous skater and winning multiple junior championships himself, the joy is not in Izumi's skating. However Izumi's coaching rep sees Teru joyously skating to Izumi's music and decides to make them a practice pair.

(Source: Lovely Mangas)

112984.description:
Are you familiar with the term Dating DV? One female mangaka wanted to depict her past even if she had to publish under a penname. It's a story about four years of being frightened by the physical and mental violence threatened by the first boyfriend she ever had in her life.... Why couldn't she break up with her lover who held a knife to her? This is a story about not letting anyone close to you become either a victim or a perpetrator of domestic violence.

(Source: Comic Days, transalted)

After waking up in a hotel and having to rush to work before she finds out who she was there with, Komatsu realizes she has no memory of the night before. Not only that, but the company darling Tachibana has taken a sudden interest in her. Was he the one she was with that night? And if so, what happened between them...and where will they go from here?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes four bonus one-shots.

The manga centers on Ponko, a tanuki who transforms into a girl in order to find a human mate and continue her species. She enters a celebrity school in order to find the best male, but is accidentally picked up by a pair of twin boys while in her tanuki form. It turns out that the Ninomiya twins are the most popular guys at her school. While the Ninomiya twins know Ponko's secret, they are willing to help Ponko out in marriage under a certain condition.

(Source: Anime News Network)

112992.description:
1. Senpai ga Boku ni Shiteru Koto (先輩が僕にシてるコト); Comic Market 94
The Asahigaoka Academy — a prestigious all-girls school known for its quality education — recently shifted to a co-ed style of education for its junior high school division, whilst its senior high school students are still all girls. Tatsumi Naeda is one of few boys enrolled for the new term. Shy and somewhat reserved, he has a hard time getting used to his surroundings, only finding some solace in the quiet of the literature club where he spends his time with its sole member, Yuno Tsuyuri, and freshman student in senior high. But little does he know that Yuno’s lack of relationships with a man has given way to an insatiable, sexual urge.

2. Senpai ga Boku ni Shiteru Koto 2 (先輩が僕にシてるコト2); Comic Market 96
Fellow member of the literature club and ace volleyball player Mitsuho confronts Naeda about his relationship with Tsuyuri and how she knows about what they do in the clubroom when no one else is around. Short of blackmailing him, she ends up experiencing first-hand just what Tsuyuri go so crazy over.

(Source: fakku)

Jihan is a college student with a special ability: he can see the future through psychic dreams. One day, he wakes up from a vivid dream about a guy who gets into a car accident. Jihan feels like it’s his responsibility to help this person, but he wasn’t able to see his face. Frustrated, he tries to brush it off with a coffee at the cafe near campus, only to realize that the barista is the guy from his dream. Will Jihan be able to save him?

Two years after being served divorce papers by his wife on Christmas Day, Itsuki is still dwelling on the past, unable to move on. Having drunk himself into oblivion, he wanders into a gay bar where he meets Minato for the first time.
